songs.title: Ai Alung Laicna Apu Daengc thangc

lines: 1    Ai Alung Laicna Apu Daeng Thangc
1. Ai alung laicna Apu daeng thangc tat dat kan ni the.
Heic kandih khou neihlaa ’baanvthaypui bamv ai how mak ge;
Apu na de ata tineihlaa khang.
Ai rui Nang Lat liamna tat khwan sihnic,
2. Kandih ramgai khou chakin swna ai rui ruantat the.
Kandih chakin rui ata tingsaeng tineihlaa ngammak;
Apu na de ata tineihlaa khang.
3. Apumtan, syan-lanv naimei guay tei su-amaan ngam the,
Neihlaana tat bammei chaenglwan guay tei nic ’num ngam the;
Apu daeng thangc guangna ney dat ni the.
4. He apu ai maanvloumei guay nzianna kuaklou o.
Nang nac kawlou khang biuh mak sihnic Nang bangc ’swlou o;
Ai tingsaeng Nang siamruai sw dat ni the.
Aram nyngtyng takh hei rui saa ngam thuylak ge.
Kachaekc kaphut kai tei ch’ryn e!
Mi guay rui abumaengc tiringc ngam pwni cho?
O, mihei ruina ringc ngam lak ge!
Abraham le! Lazar ta kabaanc twan khou,
Suhmei mai rui ai khaengv ngammak khe.
Khuaic tu khang chaengmun khou guang e.
Kum khwan sihnic Ravguangc rui ’zian e.
Tingkauh kandic guang makna maikwam tat kan the.
Dungc bammei ta howna kamei rui ning ngammak!
Kum khwan sihnic kamei ringc dat mak.
Nang pyrun tei laa mak khangrui,
Nang khou naimei tei ’tipna sin o.
Apu khourui tingkauh thangcrui key kanmei,
Azanc thanh tei karuc khou ai rui hylou ni.
2. Ngammei guay ta tei ai ruina,
Heic khoutei rui tatpat dat lak khe.
Nang hei chaengc nic chaengc ranv mak ge;
Nang rui chaenghmei ta Ai kahaw e.
Chaengc nic chaengc ranv kham makmei,
Ai neihlaa the ’taw mu ringcsuangmei laatow the.
Ringhmei tampy khou ai lungc pwni. (3)
Lungc nipui ramc tei ai nkhwan ngam mak!
2. Tingkauh ramgai khou ai lungh khang,
Kalvari cross khou ata liulou the.
Kazei luangckeymei tei nang nic laalou la tho.
Tingkauh ramc khou tingsaeng zaeng lungh khang. (3)
3. Mbaanv chwn guay mpat la tho.
Nangniw pumc hei Ravguangc tuang kaipat re.
Lungning nthan makmei tingsaeng ryanraa pwni.
Neihkhat panty luaina ai tat pwni.
Lungning mik rui how tangc thuy mak tingkauh ramc tei;
Lwmmei paanrui tingkauh khou lungc ni. (3)

songs.title: Ai Lungh' Bamv Hei Syangloupui Bamv

lines: Jisu Nang guangcdic tangh’ nungc kiu ningtowlou o.
Pou’ khwan chu ’khou ai bam ngammak.
Jisu Nang guangcdic guang’ nungc kiu ningtowlou o.
2. Gaypui ganv hei kating dui e;
Zinghmei muangc rui gumliam bam khou ’khavlou na ro.
Kaganv kaguay Nang khangrui na sinsw ni the.
Syangloupui sauc pyrun tei nic runtou sihnic.
1. Rey khou taanhmei tei ai taanc dat mak khe; (3)
2. Rey khou saamei lat ai saa dat mak khe; (3)
3. Rey khou suanmei lu ai suan dat mak khe; (3)
4. Simei taektw guay ai tu dat mak khe; (3)
5. Zianmei champanv le, nang thu akumh cho? (3)
Nang nic Puancthanh changhmei the cho?
6. Ntaw Khrista khou nang guang mak gethei (3)
Nang Tingkauh chaeng tei maan pwni.

songs.title: Ai ruina Thay the Kachangc Changhna

lines: 7    Ai Ruina Thay the, Kachangc Changhna
1. Ai ruina thay the kachangc changhna,
Mi ’baanv kandih hei akai hamh e,
Neih khatna ’gin guanglou kumh tuang de;
Neih khatna ’gin guanglou kumh tuang de.
Tingsaengc lak khe, ai han dat ni the,
Neihlaa zaenggay lu suan ’cham ni the.
Amuan guangmei khwantei rui saa e:
Khatsihnic amaan ni tuang hamh e.
Tingkauh kandic tei tangc pwkhou kiu,
Neihlaana tingkauh thangc suan dat ni.
Poubauhmei, alung rui Nang ta thuanc e;
Azybamv khourui Nang ta kalum e:
Ai hei chuanchayna apumtan maek khe,
Kum sihnic abumaengc hei Nang tuang de;
Apumtan rui Nang siamruai sw ngammak,
’Ki abumaengc rui Nang siamruai sw ni.
Nang ramrianraa paekri sihnic tangh mak.
Alung ryanraamei muangh zingh kumc sihnic,
Gethsamani ryanraa ta tangc thuy mak.
Poubauhmei Nang pamv ai nzwan guang e.
Kandih khouhei akai maek khwan sihnic,
Kachaekc kaidai tei akai sw ni the.
Bumaengh pumtan hei mu mbu haihhai,
Tingkauh kaidai tangh khang anaa guang the.
1. Ai tabui taanc e thei ringcsuangmei laa ni cho?
Kandih puat rui ata gu’ ngam mak,
Maansei ningmei rui nic gu’ ngam mak,
2. Meic khat rui Poubauhmei Jisu daeng khou guang e.
Ringhbamv lam khou kamei phu khwan e:
3. ’Niw panty khou guloupui ganv tat ri e thei,
Kandih panty hei luai guang pwkhou,
Theihpui bamv t’rou khoutei tat nii mak.
4. Ntaw hei nuhpui ganv e ringcsuangmei laa khang.
Jisu rui kros khou theicloumei tei,
Lwmmei guay rui ringhmei laa pwni.
Aseic di the ringhmei laa khang.
5. ’Zianmei nunc le, lunghlaic tho ringcsuangmei laa khang.
Ut rui ’pinh mai khou gutmei ’chiw e,
1. Ai tingmik ’thuih Kaipouc Nang thei lay tat ni.
Ai hei Kaipouc Nang tuang e.
Chaeng khou ai punkey bam khwan sihnic,
Nang hei akaipouc swlou bam e.
Ting neih siguang sihnic ai Nang tuang;
Tingsaeng zaeng khang ai Nang tuang sw ni the.
Ai hei Kaipouc Nang tuang e.
2. Meic nunc rui karaeng zauczih guang pwsihnic,
Ai hei Kaipouc Nang tuang e.
Champanv rui ata ganclou duc pwsihnic,
Ai hei Kaipouc Nang tuang e.
3. Kandih kabamv ’thuih khou ruan tat bam sihnic,
Ai hei Kaipouc Nang tuang e.
Ai theic nic ringc nic tabui guang pwsihnic,
Ai hei Kaipouc Nang tuang e.

songs.title: Ai Thay the Kamei Akaipouc Kiu e

lines: 11     Ai Thay The Kamei Akaipouc Kiu e
1. Ai thay the kamei akaipouc kiu e.
Kagangv tingsaengcna paapc rui ata guanghtu.
Kamei Kalvari khou theihmei nsaa hamh e,
Ai ringhbamv laa khang e Kamei theihmei.
Apaap tei phucna ai ping e,
Poubauhmei Nang bamna ai ping mak.
Nang khou rui ducna ai tat dat lak khe.
2. Kagangv tingsaengcna simei khou ruan tat.
Gay taanv taanh khang apanty dui guang kumc the.
Akumh ni cho Poubauhmei le, 'khavlou na ro!
Nkhuaipui taanv guay ai taanc dat lak khe.
3. Nang rui Kalvari khou tei ryanraana,
Zei keymei tei alung rui ning taan mak ge.
Hei tei akhang rui hamhna cho Poubauhmei le!
Nkhuaipui chwn guay ai ning dat lak khe.
Tingsaengc lak khe Jisu guang khang.
Laalou la tho kaganv gay khou,
Khaengv thaymei ganv hei luai pwkhou,
Guang la tho nang bumaengc ringh khang.
Nyan lamc e tingsaengc la ri tho;

songs.title: Apaap Guay Phuc Pwkhou Tingkauh thangc

lines: 1. Apaap guay phuc pwkhou tingkauh thangc,
Neihkhat mu latzan khou ai ding ni.
Ai ley ngammak ge Ravguangc hu khou,
Thow nai cho ata gulou ngammei?
Ch'ryn e Jisu zauzian daic ranv e!
Ai duak ni zauzian' rui latzan khou,
2. Paapc zaeng Jisu ta kros khou swluai.
Kamei khaengvlou the aniw paap khang.
Jisu na de 'niw ta gu' ngammei.
Duipui lev taruaih ram kaguay ta,
Latzan sw ni nkhamhpui nungc kiu.
4. Ringhmei latrik khou zanh maekmei guay ,
Jisu khou lwmlou makmei guay ta,
Tingsaeng zaeng ryanraa khaengv bam pwni.

songs.title: Apanty Khouhei Ai rui Jisu ta Ariu Pwni

lines: Apanty khou hei ruina Jisu ta ariu pwni
Ata laa khang key pwni paapc
2. Abumaengc hei ruina nic Kalat tei
3. Kamei key datpui nungc kiu ai rui
4. Pou' Jisu ta nzian o, Kalatdanv
Nang ta phungckulou pwni gay liangmei
1. Apanty luaina 'khamhpui tingmik guang nungc kiu,
Zinghmei duipui ai kaanpat nungc kiu,
Kadanmei nai lak khe chu-zaenghmei Tingkauh khou,
Kauh kaidai chaeng khou tat nungc kiu.
2. Bumaengh lungc nipui kaidai ramgai saa ngammak,
Nzianmei pwan liu rihri bam e.
3. Adihkamv neihlaa ni duipui kaanpat nungc kiu!
Gaanc gaymei Tingkauh khou lungc pwkhou,
Gaymei baanch'raa guay lev ai lungc ni.
1. Aringcbamv lev amairam kiu Ravguangc e.
Thow ta ai rui pingbam nina cho?
Ringhmei lev pumtan tei Ravguangc e,
Thow ta ai pingbam nina cho?
2. Ravguangc khourui ai ramh khatna kahaw e,
Karamgai tei ai how khang ning e,
Ravguangc kai khou lungc bam ni the.
Zanhpumc panty hei luai mak khou.
Kakumc ai nic cross phungc ni the.
Apanty nai saanv thuanc bam ni.
2 Apumc guay Nang tuang swlou o,
Alung khou Nang guang bamlou o,
Nang bam pwkhou zinghmei maek ge.
Paapc sw mak khang nic dinclou o,
1 Ata gupatlou the, ata gupatlou the,
Ata gupatlou the, ata gupatlou the,
He Ravguangc Nang ramzian hei ch'ryn e;
2 Sauh pyrun runlouna akhang kazei keylou,
Sauh pyrun runlouna akhang kazei keylou,
3 Zinghmei bamv khouruina ata thuakpatlou the,
Zinghmei bamv khouruina ata thuakpatlou the,
Duithuak paengc khou thaumei thingbang kumcna,
Kamaan zangcna kabwan gaymei buan khang,
Bumaengh taanv thaymei mbuthau diu khang.
Sw 'thanlou o, aniw guay lungning hei,
Timaanlou o, reynungc lungning guay tei;
Lungning gaymei kumcna gay bam diu khang,
Heic ramc gaymei khoutei ai guang nuh khang.
2 Ringc changh pwni de ryanraa bam sihnic;
Jisu lim bangc khoutei ringhmei nai e.
Ravguangc rui lingcloumei bang theic dat mak;
Hei kandic 'maan sihnic 'maan dat lak khe.
Swan pyrun runpui nungc kiu guang diu khang,
Khoutei guang khang Jisu rui kaw bam e;
Mbaanvthaymei tingkauc khou guang diu khang.

songs.title: Baibal khou Tunac Gaanv Ruh P'ry

lines: 21 Baibal khou Tunac Gaanv Ruh P'ry
1 Babal khou tunac gaanv ruh p'ry khou saalou e:
Gaanv panguh rui chamdaanv, panguh rui chamdaanv mak.
Chamdaanvmei nunc rui kaniw maibungc khou thauh nai;
Chamdaanv makmei nunc karaeng sin bam.
Lauhwan ny, kalaan ganv khou ni cho?
Kandihmei nunc rui kaganv tei thay ngam mak.
2 Tunac gaanv panguh rui gaanv panguh khou saa e:
Nangniw thaucdui tei aniw khang nic tiilou o.
Mi ganv khoutei tunac gaanv panguh rui saa e:
Nangniw tatna zuanh' bamv thangc laa tho.
3 Mi ganv khou tei tunac gaanv panguh tat kan the.
Nowpouc tei rui guangna kaikhamv mbangh kan the.
Heic khoutei kaniw guangna kaikhamv nchow the;
Nowpouc rui kaniw ta thay mak khe.
4 Jisu rui key dat nipui ganv tei 'naaguang the,
Kamei nunc ta laa khang Kamei key dat pwni.
Heic ganv khoutei chamdaanvna bammei nunc tei rui,
Tingsaeng zaeng neihlaana thuanc bam ni.
Guangh Thanh puanhmei ta kalum khang.
Kauh liangmei khou hymdaic kan diu.
Guangh Thanh puanhmei ta kalum khang.
Thau tho, aniw kunghmei lanv lev.
Guangh Thanh puanhmei Khrista khou kiu.
'Niw lungh khat chwn khat sw khang
Khristian e twmei meic nunc how kan diu.
Hu biak thangc tatgut bam ni,
He nzianmei nang nic zauc lo,
Pwan thanh tei piu pwni the.
Pwan thanh tei piuna thuanc ni,
3. Tingsaeng zaeng pwan thanh piu lana,
Ravguangc paanrui lungh neihlaamei nai e.
Kandih lungh ryanraa ramc khouhei bam saengc
Nang hamhna apumtan baihmei maek ge,
Alung ryanraamei nai lak khe Ravguangc.
Nang zauzian paanrui ai ntaw ringhmei laa the;
Ravguangc laalou na ro, kandih ryanraa ramc khou.
Ntaw thu zinghmei bamv khourui ai duakpat the.
Ravguangc 'khavlou na ro, kandih ryanraa ramc
1. Bumaengh thai chakiu hei nthai la tho.
Latryan geih thangc nang rui piu bam sihnic,
Tingkauh kai thangc nang khang bamv maek ge.
2. Nang rui lingcloumei nang tay dat pwni.
Zanh pumc swna suai makna tay dat ni.
3. Thow kumhmei rui bumaengh khou lingc ethei,
Gaypui taanv taanh khang tei ranvlou la tho;
Thaymakpui ganv khou tay dat pwni.
1. Bw neih gaanchuangcna guay ta samc rilouna,
'Zianmei nunc tat lak nimei guay ta
Kata thuanh khang samc kan ni the,
Neihriw kage maek khe, heic ramc thangc tei,
2. Kaidai chaeng khou ai neihlaana ruan bam ni.
Bam duc khwan tho kadylou khang maek khe.
3. Tingkauh ramgai tei thow rui saa ngam ni cho!
'Zianmei nunc lev ringhmei pyrun run khang,
Ringhpouc khou duploumei rui gay e.
Guangh nunc khou ngangvloumei suangc mu,
Ringhpouc khou duploumei rui gay e.
How makmei ric dou nimei tei,
Ringhpouc bumaengc paan rui ngam ni.
Huayney ranvmei guay rui rih hei ngam ni.
Hallelujah kaucna thuanc bam ni the.
Napguy tei minc nzinh ngam the,
Khuam kaduai nipui ganv di the.
Lau guay tei minc nzinh ngam the;
Nap guay saamh khou phungcguang pwni.
Ravguangc key dat nimei ganv 'naa the.
Kamei guang nimei ganv thay mak ge.
Kaipouc guang khou "gay the" twlou pwni cho?
Meic nac kathuih rui Kata how ni.
Thow pwsihnic kapaap nkamh ngammak ge.
Paapc phunghmei nunc khang ch'rynpui tingmik!
3. Chamdaanv mak khou Kamei guang pwni,
Lwm bam khou Kata sowriu pwni,
Kamei nunc neihlaana Kata sowriu ni;
Neihlaa zaenggay daic liangmei sw ni.
4. Nang tuang thaucmai daanc gaancna bam o.
Kamei rui lwmmei guay ta laathau pwkhou,
Lwm makmei ta ganclou duc pwni.
1. Chamdaanv latho lwmloumei guay nyan la ritho.
Matat khatna khang de aniw panty hei mu;
Kandih khouhei gay chuymei lev kamanv kunghmei,
Kandih akai amaan ngam kan sihnic,
Kandih khouhei lungc suang nimei akai maek ge;
2. Nang khang tiiloumei syan-lanv kaguayna ruc khou,
Nang liantimei taanv tei taanh khang tii tuang hamh e,
Kandih khouhei ramh khatsihnic phungcguang mak ge,
Ramh khatsihnic phungctat dat khang maek ge.
3. 'Zianmei khwan rui kawna bame ryanraamei guay,
Kandih hou Ravguangc rui ryanraa lakmei guay ta,
Lwmloumei guayna khang Kazauzian tiilou e;
Nrianhloumei ramc khou phungc guang lou ni.
Ai kumhmei paapc phunghmei nac khang,
Karam zianlou ai makumh ngam thuy mak.
Apumtan akhwan naipui kamv thuanc bam sihnic,
Thuanc kim thuy lak ge ch'rynmei Jisu zauzian.
Nang khuay guay tei kuaklou pwni,

songs.title: Ch'rynpui Ramzian rui Aniw ta Gulou

lines: 33 Ch'rynpui Ramzian Rui Aniw ta Gulou
1. Ch'rynpui ramzian rui aniw ta gulou,
Tat di kho tingkauh ramc guangtangh mak saanv.
2 Tingkauh Jubilee kaeng hiwna bam khou,
Lungcsi lungcgay ta kadaa mak ge.
Guang niimei guay tingkauh Jubilee khou,
3. Aniw pumc guay bumaengh, pumc sw pwni.
Aniw phey-baan karaan dat lak khe.
Tingkauh mei lwn 'guanhna lungc bam pwni;
4. Tingkauh ramc khoutei aniw lungh khangrui,
Simei paap ta mpatlou la tho.
Ringhmei latrik khou zanh hylou makmei,
Tingkauh ramc gut nuh lak ge.
1. Chu lo tingkauhmei guay lev kandihmei guay le,
Ai rui makuatthauloumei nac nunc guày rui,
2. Kiruai guay sihnic kakaipouc lwn tei thay e;
Ai kaw bammei hei chulou o.
3. Kaipouc rui saa e guango kaphianh kariu kho,
Ai rui gunh kumcna khiu mphwanlou pwni,
Khrista rui kaw e akhou ngalancguang o.
Hanguang dat ro twna kaw bam e.
Nyan la ritho kaganv maek khe,
Kamei dingthau dat makna bam nina cho?
Dingthau dat ro twna kauc bam e.
Kamei hanguang dat makna bam nina cho?
Nangniw chaeng maanvna tat bammei guay,
Hanguang dat ro twna kaw bam e.
4. Ringhpouc rui saa e, ramhthay la tho.
Kaganv rii pwkhou nang kapna huay pwni.
Ntaw hanguang dat makmei guay mu,
Thei thang ningngam makmei sw pwni.
Aniw hei Ravguangc nac nunc e.
Pou' ta how ngam mak ge.
Ta 'duanghna lungc bam e Pou' rui.

songs.title: Chwnsi Zaengsi Nai dat lak khe

lines: 37 Chwnsi Zaengsi Nai Dat Lak khe
1. Chwnsi zaengsi nai dat lak khe,
Aniw guang tangc pwkhou, 'niw neihlaa 'chamc ni.
Chwnsi zaengsi nai dat lak khe,
2. Kandih ryanraa nai dat lak khe,
Tingkwm ching ching thuanc bam ni,
Tingkauh Jirusalem Thanh khou lungc pwni.
2. Ai zinghmei ramc khouhei lungh ryanraana
He ata riulou ni, lungh kabiuna kapmei
lat hei saa dat lak khe.
4. Mi ramc tei tangh khang kandih ryanraa rui
He ai 'khwan e nang ramc thanh khou lungh khang tei;
Alung kwnmei Nang na de Poubauhmei.
Ai duploupui bamv Nang na de;
Nang Bumaengc rui atan nduanghlou o.
Nang hamhna ai neihlaa khang maek.
Mang kumhmei apanty hei maan pwni;
Neih key kumcna key kan pwni.
Thau kan the apanty dui luangh kumcna.
Jisu ramgai meic nunc how kan diu!
Kata thay makmei nunc hu khou,
Seitaan tuang phaypanv gaymei sw bam rio.
2. Jisu ramgai meic nunc guay nic,
3. Nangniw thu Ravguangc nac nunc e;
Meic nunc rui nang ta zauc bam e;
Thanmei nunc khoutei lungc bam e.
Thuanhpui lu rui kachaekc kaidai khoutei
O, adihkamv gay tu cho (Heic khoutei).
Thuanhpui lu rui kachaekc kaidai khoutei
He Poubauhmei chaeng tei laanclou o,
2. Heicpui kandic khou ai n-gin tat bam e:
Paapc ric ta ngamlouna Jisu lev tat 'chamc ni.
3. Nthiammei rui ata bam haengv pwsihnic,
Paapc ric ta ngamlouna Jisu ley tat chamc ni,

songs.title: Edenramc Gay Khou tei Lungh khan

lines: 42 Eden Ramc Gay khoutei Lungh khang
1. Eden ramc gay khou tei lungh khang,
Neih khat panty luaipui nungc kiu,
Guang tangc pwni kauh kaidai khou.
Tingkauh ramc khou ruanna tat bam.
Mbaanv ramc khou lungc nii mak khe:
Tat kan di kho zianmei nunc le.
2. Mang thangc how gaymei khang suangc e;
Lauziu Nac rui gaancna bam e.
Maeng maan ri tho kaganv maek khe.
3. Kanaan ramc tangh mak khang lungh geic.
Zinghmei muangc rui guamliam bam e.
Ringhmei thing lim khou zaengsw ni.
4. Neih khat tingkauh thangc ai ruan tat.
Han dat nii mak, han dat nii mak.
Nuhlou mak ge Pou' Khrista rui;
Han guang dat the kandih ramc khou.
Nang bumaengc ringhmei tei laatow diu khang,
Nang lungning khou Abumaengc lungclou the,
Cross tei phungcna dinc tat khang nuhlou the.
Alat rui thandibaeng swna rih tei adow tat ro.
2. Ping riu, rouh riu baucna tat ro.
Nang sian kamc 'tipna hu thangc tatgut ro.
Zinghmei bamv khou zipri bammei guay khou,
Nang latdyn guay khou nkhavlou pwni.

songs.title: Gaychamv Dinh Khang Nang ta Kawe

lines: 44      Gaychamv Dinh khang Nang ta Kaw e
1. Gaychamv dinh khang nang ta kaw e;
Kabamv kathuih khou dinc tat khang.
Ringhchamv chu makmei ching ching khou,
Dinc tat khang nang ta kaw bamn e.
2. Taanc nimei chaeng peyna nai e:
Nang syan nang lanv tiipat nuh e;
Nang pumc kahak tiipat nuh e.

songs.title: Gaychamv Dinctat khang Nang Pumc Tiipat ro

lines: 45 Gaychamv Dinc Tat khang Nang Pumc
1. Gaychamv dinc tat khang nang pumc tiipat ro;
Nang syan-lanv guay rui gaychamv dinc tat ro;

1. Guangh Jisu guang dat zaic pwni the,

Lauziu guay lev ziuh guay ta lou baihpui nungc kiu,

songs.title: Guanghdic Khat Thau Bow dat Nuh e

lines: 56 Guanghdic Khat Thau, Bow Dat Nuhe
1. Guanghdic khat thau, bow dat nuh e;

'Kic Ravguangc Lat mu kalaic dat lak;
Ringhbamv laa khang tingsaeng zaeng khang
3. Kandih puat hei tingsaengh mak ge;
'Kic Ravguangc Lat mu kalaic dat mak;
Paapc ric rui tanc-bauc khwan sihnic,
Neihlaana bam kan diuc khang rui;
3. Karaan guay nic 'maan ngam kan the,
He tabui nungc tangc nina cho ?
Ai rui ning e tingsaeng kai tei,
Amucna ai lungc bam khwan e.
Mi kandic ramgai hei tingsaeng zaeng
He charyn e Katuang zauzian hei;
2. Kandih puat ta ai phu khwan e;
Kandih lungc suangpui bamv hamh e:
Heic kandic rui ata tineihlaa ngammak ge.
Hanguang dat the ai nang pamv khou.

Ravguangc rui nang chabwan ganv khou
Nang chabwan ganv gay khou hei,

He chabwan nunc, nang puangc chuy' khou

Lwmloumei kaikhunc mu ntamvpui lwn how dat lak khe.

Latzan sw pwni the heic kandih mei guay ta.
Gaytaanv taancloumei nic siimei taanv taancloumei guay nic,

Ringhmei Lat dinhmei rui kachyn the.

Tingsaeng zaeng ringc nimei Khrista na de.
Kataanv taancna Kasiamruai sw khang nai.
Zanh pumc khou bumaengh kazauh mak gethei,

Nang pumtan hei naipui saanv khou,

Mi hei nang rui taanc nimei taanv kiu e.
3. Neihlaamei panty khou lungh khang ruina.
Kataanv hei nang taanc nina de.
Khrista zanc khourui nang tatpatlou o.
65 He Khristian mei Nuncle, Ntipna Ding o
1. He Khristianmei nuncle, ntipna ding o,
Seitaan ric tei tancguang pwni the.
Nang mik rakpatna hu thangc zaucpat ro:
Lwmmei na rui rih tei ngam pwni the.
Suan pwni rih ngampui lu tei.
Rih ngammei pyrun tei run lana,
Baanch'raa guay lev lu suan bam ni.
2. Poubauhmei tuang thandibaeng tei sin lana,
Tatpat la tho Jisu ta zaucna.
Ngam khang "khavlou pwni kadan bam rio.
Baucna tatgut ro nang hu thangc zaucna.
3. Ngammeipu Jisu ricpwan tei piu lana,
Adow tho Seitaan ric ta ngam khang.
Rih ngam lana guangmei guay khangtei mu,
Rih ngammei pyrun tei runlou pwni.
4. Poubauhmei Jisu zanc khourui rih ngam ni,
Suai makna Seitaan ric tei ngam ni.
Adih gay ni cho rih ngamguang ethei.
1. He Jisu Nang gaanhmei kumc aniw hei,
Tingsaeng gaanc bam diu khang rui,
Tiilou o Nang riw gaanhmei tei akhou.
Kandihmei guay rui Nang ta thuanc bam ni.
He Ravguangc, Nang ngamv charyn e;
Lu suanna thuanc bam pwni 'thanmei guay.
Baanch'raa nunc rui thuancna bammei khoutei,
Ai nic thuanc taek makna thuanc bam ni the.
2. Tingkauh ramc khou tei lungc kan diu khangrui,
Theicloumei tei nang laalou zihna cho?
Kakhou lwm tho tingkauh khou zaylou ni.
3. Kandih khou aniw lungcna bam sihnic,
'Ai bamv chamdaanv khang tat ni he' tw e.
Nang ta nzianna kaw bam the.

Nang khuay guay Ravguangc khou pat tho.

Nzianmei khwan rui kaw bam the,
Nang taanv rui nang ta maikwam khou
Ai machunh e Nang guangcdic tingkauhramc tei.
He ai ning liange neihlaamei tingkauhramc.
Tabui nungc rui tangc ni cho?
Tabui nungc rui ai guangtangc ni cho?
T'ui nungcrui ai how ni cho?
He ai ning liang e neihlaamei tingkauhramc.
A-Kaipouc rui ata nduanghlou bam e.
Kandih ryanraamei guay tei ning dat lak khe.
Bw neih gaanhmei nai lak khe;
Ting pwanzingh lev ryanraamei nai dat lak khe;
Lauziu Nac rui gaanc bam e;
He ai ning liang e neihlaamei tingkauhramc.
1. He nzianmei khwan rui nang ta kawna bam khou.
Akhou guang o, twna niamhna kaw e.
Guang nyanmei sw la rio, 'zianna kaw bam khouhei;
Akhou guang o, Ai zaeng tithaekclou ni.
Nang puatrith tei Ai rui laaganclou ni.
2. He 'zianmei Poubauhmei rui kawna bam khouhei,
Ngalancguang o, theihmei paap bam khourui.
Nang khuay guay kuaklouna nang ta sw 'thanlou ni:
3. Ngamp'rimei Guangh Jisu rui kawna bam khouhei,
Duploupui bamv maekmei Nang nac guay ta,
Kachac lakmei taudaic lang khou guangna dup tho;
Theihmei paap ngamv khourui guduaklou ni.
4. Ntaw kaganv gay khou Jisu khou guang la tho;
Duakpat la tho paapcmei kandih tuang phac khourui;
Lunghlaic dat nuh makpui ganv guang pwni.
Nthanmei Ravguangc Lat rui 'niw ta kaw bam e.
Lunghlaic guang o zinghmei bamv khouruina;
Asaanh makna 'maan ngam 'ni the heic kandic hei.
Ravguangc guangcdic tei how ngam ni tuang hamh e.
2. Kaganv tingkwm hei neihkhat khat swna,
Kaganv hei tingmik kathuih anaa ranv guang the.
Asaanh makna heic kandic lev 'maan 'chamc pwni.
3. Ravguangc lev tingsaeng lungc nchamc khangrui;
Tingsaeng ryanraamei maikwam khoutei gut mak khang;
Ganclou ngamna nzwanguang tho 'taw Khrista khou.

songs.title: He Paapcmei Ntaw T'ui Thangc Bam tu cho ? -

lines: 71 He Paapcmei Ntaw T'ui Thangc Bam Tu Cho
1. He paapcmei, ntaw t'ui thangc bam tu cho ?
Nang panty nai bammei kaganv lungc khou.
Kandih mwnpwang gaymei khou lungc bam khou.
Mitei rui theihmei khou zaylou pwni
"Nang puancthanh nina de, kaganv nai bam khouhei,
'Maanmei ta gulou khang nkhwan bam the:
Ntaw kahak Adaeng khou guang la tho,
Nang paap kaguay tei kuaklou pwni the."
2. He paapcmei, ntaw kaganv nai bam khou,
Lungh laic la tho kaganv ri pwni the;
Tatri kan pwkhou kapna huay pwni.
3. Ntaw hei kanloumei kaganv kiu the.
Guloumei ganv ta tatri nina cho ?
Gulou khangrui ntaw nkhwan bam the,
He paapcmei, Jisu daeng khou guang la tho.
Ai hei sansi liangmei paapcmei e.
Achaeng lwan hei zingc khithkhit key the:
Gaanhmei riw tei tiilou na ro.
Arup 'ryan guay thu gaanhmei khou bam:
Chwn siina bammei hei araana kumc the:
Taanc niimei taanv guay taanc bam sihnic,
Ntaw thu Nang pamv khou guang dat the;
74 He Ravguangc Nang Chwn Dinclou o
1. He Ravguangc Nang chwn dinclou o;
Dungcna bam khang ny tatna bam khang cho ?
Napchu guay khuamguang khang kawlou tu cho ?
Nkhwan bam e, he Ravguangc, Nang chwn tei.
Duidai ramv khou nic, tauh ramv khou pwnic,
Zinghmei lim rui ata liamguang sihnic,
Minc bammei napguy guay ta'pat lak khe.
Raam kan ni the minc bammei napguy guay;
Raam kan nimei ta thow khuamguang ni cho?
Tingzyn neihmik key mak khou khuamguang khang.
Nang rui hamhna neihlaa khang maek ge.
Lili mwn kumc tuai nuangc e.
1. He Ravguangc Nang ram zian hei ch'ryn dyng e,
Tampypeic sw khang nang rui ata damclou.
Tamzanh thaymei pui sw diu khang tilou o;
Ai ramh khatsihnic thay mak ge Ravguangc.
Nang suaihiam sing chakna ai lungc bam ni.
Nang tuang nyngtyng gaymei akhou tiilou o;
Khristian kaikhunc ramgai lungc lyan ngam khang,
He Ravguangc Nang suaihiam tiikeylou o.
2. Kaikhunh khou nchu nzaenghna lungh khang,
Ravchap tatmei pui swna lungc lyan ngam khang,
Ravguangc kahawmei panty khou lungc diu khang,
Ravguangc khang tipat thayna lungc diu khang.
Ngalanc guang e akhuay guay kuaklou diu khang.
Tingsaeng Nang siamruai sw dat khang laalou o.
Tingsaeng neihlaamei panty khou lungh khang.

songs.title: He Tingkauh Ramc Guang Niimei nunc mu

songs.title: Heic Kandic hei Mu Ningsumhpui Kandic e

lines: 78 Heic Kandic Hei Mu Nyngsumhpui Kandic e
1. Heic kandic hei mu nyngsumhpui kandic e.
Heicpui 'dic ta Jisu ruina gulou the.

Heic kandic ta damclou khwan e.

Bumaengh ta nsaa 'rai bam tu cho?
2. Ravguangc rui 'niw ta baanh zaapna kaw bam e.

Tingsaeng zaengna tingkauh Salem khou ai ruan ni
3. Heicdi nritmei cross tei ai phungc ngam ni cho ?
Paapc tuang ric tei tingmik kathuih adow sihnic
Hymdaihmei Ravguangc ta thuanhpui khwan rui suan ni
4. Kandih hei zauc pwki ai neihlaa khang maek ge.
Zinghmei ruina gumliamna bampui ramc khouhei
Kumsihnic ngammei Ravguangc Jisu zanc khourui

songs.title: Heic Kandicramc hei Mu Akai Hamh

lines: 80 Heic Kandihramc Hei Mu Akai Hamh e
1. Heic kandihramc hei mu akai hamh e;
Neih khatna khang nggin guangpui kai de;
Tingsaeng lungc nipui kai hamh e.
Ai tingkauh gaymei ramc thangc tat kan ni the.
Ai kaamcthau kan ni the 'zianmei guay le;
Bamduc khwan tho, bamduc khwan tho.
2. Neihlaa lunghkim khang maek kandih khouhei,
3. 'Zianmei guay le, paapc ta mpat la tho,
Aseic hei Ravguangc rui nang ta kawe.
Mi kandic rui ata tikim ngam mak,
Kaganv maek khe chamdaanv la tho.

songs.title: Heic kandic hei Mu Neihkhat Amaan Pwni

lines: 81 Heickandic hei mu Neihkhat Amaan Pwni
1. Heic kandic hei mu neihkhat amaan pwni:
Baanh rui kasiamhmei guay hei amaan nuh tuang de.
Tihkic lwmmei guay mu amaan tuang nai lak khe:
Ntakmei rui kai swmei kumh tuang de.
Nangniw Ravguangc kai e nthan liangmei kai e
Ravguangc kai thu 'than e nangniw thu hei tei e
2. Khrista ruc khou kaiphwn swna lunghmei guay,
Neihlaamei laa pwni panty hei luai pwkhou;
Nang taanv paan khouruina nang Swan laatow pwni
Kumna aseic kai hei katgut dat re.
3. Khrista ruc khou swthaumei kaiphwn guay mu,
Kachaekc lev daengka kamanv kunghmeikai guay e.
Tihkic thingnwang panu rui swthaumei guay mu,
Heic kandic hei mu neihkhat amaan pwni;
Nkhamhpui nungc maikwam khou lou pwni.
4. Khrista ruc khou hamhna kaiphwn baihmei maek.
Nthiammei pwanzingh rui kanuk ranvguang sihnic,
Khrista ruc khou swpui zaengrui kachanh lak ge.
Kumna aseic kai hei katgut dat re.

songs.title: Heic Kandic hei Nouha Kaanc khou Kumc the -

lines: 82 Heic Kandic hei Nouha Kaanc khou Kumc the
1. Heic kandic hei Nouha kaanc khou kumc the:
Kandih ramgai mbaanv rui kahawmei tei
Phu khourui theic 'maan ngam kan the.
Charyn tuang e heic kandic hei!
Luangh lev duipui kabamv kalaic pwni;
2. Heic kandic hei nkhamhpui ganv guang the.
Mbaanv rui kahawmei ta nzian khourui,
3. Heic kandic hei kadunhna lungc pwni,
Akumh ni cho kandih khou lunghmei guay hei;

songs.title: Heic Kandic khou Ai rui Guangmei

lines: 83 Heic Kandic khou Ai rui Guangmei
1. Heic kandic khou ai rui guangmei;
Nruay guay rui thingphaanv gay khou,
Pou' Jisu rui khwan bam e.
Tingsaengc lak khe heic kandic hei.

songs.title: Heic Kandic Mu Zinghmei Raana de

lines: 84 Heic Kandic Mu Zinghmei Raana de
1. Heic kandic mu zinghmei raana de;
Kandih khouhei gaymei ariu ngammak ge.
He a-Ravguangc Nang riw gaanhmei tei
Zaeng 'thaekcpui bamv maek ge kandih khou,
Tingkauh ta machunhna bam di kho.
2. Kandih taanv khou lunghgut dat ri tho;
Bumaengh taanv khou lunghgutmei guay dwan-gay ni.
Ravguangc rui saaloumei latryan kiu e,
Akhou guang o, Ai zaeng tithaekclou pwni,
Akhou guangmei guay ta riuna bam e";
4. Kandihmei guay zipri bam ri tho,
Ntaw nang khang kaganv di the thau la tho;
Poubauhmei key dat khang kaganv 'naa the;
Kandih kwn guay kagaengv lik ge;
Nzianmei guay lungh khang tat kan the
Baanh sin kadymei nai lak khe;
2. Heic kandic khou suhmei naumei guay
Tat rey kanmei nzianmei nunc ta
1. Heic kandic ta Ravguangc rui damclou the;
Kalatkaeng paan rui ramh guay ta damclou;
Kabaanc kahak rui maansei ta damclou:
Ramh guay ruc sin khang maansei ta damclou.
2. Kabaansiam guay pangc khou maansei guay ta
Kumpui zaengrui latzan khou guang ding ni.
3. Taanc zi makmei taancna bammei guay ta,
Tu zi makmei tu-zangy bammei guay ta,
Saa zi makmei lat saa bammei guay ta,
Latzan sw khang tingmik anaaguang the.
4. Latzan nungc kiu nang ta saaguclou khang,
Nai pwni de twna nang ningna cho?
Mwang rui saaduak ngam nuh de twna cho?
Nang ta saagucloumei nai pwlak khe.
Bw-dow mak ge twna saaduak ngam de;
Ravguangc latzan khou thu duak ngam lak ge
Nang taanvphy tei nang khang tii pwni the.
Tingpuk kandih 'maan changh kan pwni the;
Baibal khou saaloumei hei guang khithkhit pwthe;
Poubauhmei guang datmei ganv khou kiu,
Nkamh khang tei kabamv nai dat pwlak khe,
Nang ruc khoutei latzan sw khang ruina
Maansei nac mwang rui daw hzih ngam pwlak ge;
3. Kandih khou nang taanv tynmei khangsuangc,
Nai dat pwlak khe 'maan ngam pwni the,
Ntaw kaganv gay khou kunghmei nang bumaengc ta
Gulou ngam khang chamdaanv la tho.

songs.title: Hei Poubauhmei Nang Zauzian Daihmei tei

lines: 89 He Poubauhmei Nang Zauzian Daihmei tei
1. He Poubauhmei nang zauzian daihmei tei
Nang bangc ai rui saaruan dincruan bam ni
Kalvary chyng khou nang zei luangckeylou,
Nang zauzian thukh ai saa tangc ngam thuy lak,
Jerusalem thanh khou thuancku ni the
Tingkauh thangc gaanchuangcna kumc gaanc pwni
Mbaanvthayna Jesu ta thuanc bam ni
3. Ringhmei thingbang lim gaymei bamv khoutei
Tingkauh bancharaa lev Bumaengh Than' nunc
Neihlaa zaenggaymei lu thanh khwan ruina.
Guloumeipu Jisu ta thuanc bam ni.

songs.title: Israel Nac nunc ta Jehova rui Zian e

lines: 90 Israel Nac Nunc Ta Jehovah rui 'Zian e
1. Israel nac nunc ta Jehovah rui 'zian e.
Charyn tuang e! Charyn tuang e!
Ryanraamei lung rui zauc kim ngam mak.
3. Apanty phaydyng hei zaenggaypui phaydyng e.
Jisu zei rui liuloumei kaguay rui
Maansei ta kungc liangna damclou khwan e;
Aniw khang suaihiem tei tiikeylou the.
Khoutei guang khang ai machunh bam,
1. Jisu guang pw the chamdaanvna 'khwan o.
Kamei rey liangmei nkhamh liangmei e.
Tingkauh thangc rui 'niw ta laa khang key 'ni.
Jisu suai makna han guang dat pwni.
Nkhuaimei guay ta ganclou duc pwni.
Kachangcmei guay tingkauh thangc phungc ku ni.
2. Jisu rui saa e paapc khou rui pat tho,
Nangniw lungning tei sw-nthan la tho.
Kandih khou paapc rui 'niw ta gum liam bam,
Nang thau lana Ravguangc biak liangc la tho.
3. 'Khuaimei rui 'niw ta gum liam ngam mak ge.
Seitaan ta Kalvari khou ngamlou the.
Neihlaa zaenggaymei Jisu khou nai e:
Zauzian paan rui aniw ta gulou the.
Kuak kan the apaap guay tei,
2. Kandih khou ai lungc bam saanv,
Paapc khourui pak duc tat ni;
Meic guay khou dinc lik tat khang.
Ringc kan diu arup guay nic,

songs.title: Jisu hei Lauziu Gaengc Chuymeipu Kiu e

lines: 95 Jisu Hei Lauziu Gaengc Chuymeipu Kiu e
1. Jisu hei lauziu gaengc chuymeipu kiu e.
Kamei 'zianmei lauziu guay ta pamclou e.
Katuang builwang saenghmei ruina zaylou e.
Nchu nzaenghmei duithuak khou zaylou e.
Ai hei ruan 'maanna tatmei lauziu kumcna,
Lauziu phay khat pangc khourui ai maengtat the;
'Taw ai ngalanc guang dat the a-Poubauhmei.
2. Kamang alaih mwang khouruina kanlou the.
Kanganv maekmei duipui khou nic zaykaanlou.
Ndiakcmei phuaic ding khou ata zaylou e.
Ata tingsaeng zaeng khang makuatlou bam e.
3. Lauziu kuanc khou guang khang kawmei tei chu lo.
Nking o, Kaipouc ruina kawmei khwan tei.
Chumei kamv rui guang katumc tho kapamv khou.
Guang tho, guang tho, ntaw kaikhamv laanc bam khou.

songs.title: Jisu Kaw e Paapc Puat Laaganh khang

lines: 96 Jisu Kaw e Paapc Puat Laaganh khang
1. Jisu kaw e paapc puat luakganh khang.
Seitaan bangc nang swbam nina cho?
Lungh laicguangmei ta kamei laa nii e.
'Taw lungh laih mak 'thei kaganv maek khe;
Kamei dinhmei ganv tei guang pwthe.
2. Khrista ruina kaw khou nang zanc ta,
Kachaekc namvdaih khou lungc zihna cho?
3. 'Khamv laanh khou gut ro twna kaw e.
Ntaw gutlou makmei guay tei mu,
Kaw sihnic ngalanc guang dat lak khe.
4. Tingkauh ramgai tei saa ngammak ge.
Baanch'raa guay lev seraphim guay tei,
Kata thuanhpui khwan rui kagaengv e.
Pou' Khrista ta how pwlak khe.
Tingkauh kandic khou lungc niimei guay.
Lungh laicna Kakhou guang la tho.
Bw lev neih riw kage maek ge.
Laudai tei tay nimei rau e.
Nang zei rui thuak patlou the.
Aniu chwn sii e nang raana
3. He Jisu Nang Lat piu diuc khang
Heic tei rui biumei hamh e
Kamei guang khou kaswan laa khang,
Kandih tingpuk guay maanpui nungc kiu.
Tingkauh chaeng khou ai tat pwni,
Guangh bamvpaeng khou guang kariu ni;
Halleluijah Zaatc guayna rui - kariu ni.
2. Kauckeypui khwan tei lev Ravguangc Baenggun khwan rui,
Kamei kahak key pwni, Khrista khou theic kanmei
Zianmei nunc tei thau rey pwni,
Mi tangv ringc bammei lev kariu ni.
3. Tingkauh kaidai thangc tei, Gaanhmei riw padik ge,
Khoutei Khrista lungc bame, Kamei lev bam' chamc ni,
Tingsaeng zaengna lungc bam ni khoutei.
4. Mphwanmei pheybaan rui Apwan swna lungc ni.
Khrista riw gaanhmei bangc khou, Kata thuanhmei khwan rui,
Trumpet khwan lev alim khwan rui,
Tingkauh kaidai khou suanna bam ni.
Nang paap guay saa ndauhpat tho;
Tingsaeng zaengna thuancna bam di kho.
Theic nuhmei bamv khourui tiduaklou the.
Ringhpouc tuang taanv daihmei tei thuancku di kho.
Thuanc o Ringhpouc ta zaatc guay rui,
Ringhmei baanc rui ata chaengzaylou the.
Ringhpouc tuang taanv daihmei tei thuancku di khou.
Aniw khang kage naimei guay tilou,
Ringhpouc suaihiam sing phucna thuancku di kho
Lwm makmei sw la ri tho;
Ngam lana thau dat kan the.
5. Thuancku o he meic guay le;
1. Jisu rui dinclou e Tingkauh Guangcdic naa the."
Siimei chamv raana padik bam the.
Nangniw lunghlaicna huayney dat rethei mu-
Nang paap guay tei kuaklou pwni,
Nang kandic tei tigaylou dat ni.
2. 'Thei hanna bammei guay nangniw lunghlaic la tho.
Gaymei taanv tei taancthau dat di kho.
3. Nineveh namvdai khou Jonah ta ndiu kumc,
Jisu guang dat zaic pwni the,
Lunghlaic tho twna dincruan tat tho.
Tu lana neihlaana zangv 'chamc la tho.
Nangniw lev Ai zangv 'chamc dat lak khe.
Lauziu nunc tei pak nkic ngam kan the.
Lungh geihmei rui zaeng 'thaekc khang maek khe.
Kasu karic sw ngam the Kaipouc khang.
Chu zaenghna zaeng thaekc nipui ramc kiu,
Ravguangc tikgunc daihmei ta thuanc ni.
3. Jisu khou lwmlou makmei guay mu,
Kandih khou lungc nchamc bam sihnic,
Tingkauh ramc khou kiu ntamv pwni.
Kandih khgou suc-rih nai dat lak khe.
Thow saa ngam cho Ravguangc ngamv ta?
1. Kaamcthau di kho Ravguangc nac nunc thiu !
Kaganv tei guangtangc changh pwni the.
Ravguangc tuang ricpwan tei piu lana,
Seitaan ric tei adow khang tatpat di kho.
Theicna bammei guay, zipri bammei guay,
Nang zip bam ni cho, nang ping makna cho?
Kandih kaganv hei guang changh pwni the;
Zipchyang thauna kataanv taanc di kho.
2. Zipchyangthau di kho, Ravguangc nac thiu.
Kaganv tingsaengc lak khe kandih hei,
Poubauhmei rui guangzauh khang guang dat pwni.
3. Kaganv gaymei ri kan pwni the.
Gaanvkhat na sihnic gut nuh lak khe.
'Thei thangc gut dat khang kaganv maek khe.
Poubauhmei rui kawpui ganv khou gut di kho.
Meic guay ta nthiam khang guang pwthe.
Bumaengh tuang ricpwan tei piu lana,
Seitaan ric ta adow khang tatpat di kho.
1. Kaganv khat khang de heic kandi akai hamh e.
Neihkhat Poubauhmei rui azanc kauckey pwkhou,
Dih hei 'patlouna akai tingkauh thangc tat ni.
Chamdaanv luai ngam the heic kandi akai hamh e
He Poubauhmei 'dih khou apam maek ge.
Tingkauh baanch'raa rui kaw bam tingkauh
Ai tat zaic ni the, heic kandic akai hamh e.
2. Kahym daihmei ramc khoutei lwmloumei guayna
Theihmei suhmei naumei ryanraamei nai lak khe;
'Baanthayna rih ngammei lu suanna bam pwni.
3. Kawmei khou gut nuh khangrui Pou' khou 'taw lwm' tho;
Lwmlou makmei nunc rui maikwam thangc tat pwni.
Tingkwm kaganv nai makna ryanraa bam pwni;
4. Arup nunc rui ata khwan bam tingkauh kai khou;
Zianmei apui-pu nic khoutei ata khwan bam.
Ai nic neihkhat tat pwni gaymei ramc khoutei
Ata puanhpui bamv heic kandic akai hamh e.
Kandih gwan guay hei nic baic ngam the.
Lungning hei tancna bam nina cho?
Kandih gwan hei nic baic ngam the,
Ntaw hei nic chamdaanv na bam the.
Kamei guang nimei ganv kiu naa the.
Lauziunac guay tingkauh khou lungc ni,
Ziuh guay ta mai khou phaiclou pwni.
1. Kaganv rau guang the, chamdaanvna bam tho;
Nzianmei guay taanv taanc la tho;
Nang kaamc thauna Kataanv taanc tho;
Nang syan nang lanv ta laa nii mak ge;
Nang bumaengc ta laa nii e.
2. Kandih ramgai phuna lungc bammei guay,
Theihmei nganvna lwm mak ge thei,
3. Ravguangc latdanv piuna lungc bammei guay,
Tingkauh ramc khou guang lungc ni.
4. Kandih khou lwmlouna theic kanmei guay,
Kaganv gaymei guay ri ngam the.
Apumtan gaymei guay nic piu 'maan ngam the.
Ai guang dat the Kaipouc pamv khou;
2. Paapc tuang ramgai khou tat khang ata 'thiam bam.
Theihmei paap rui guanghtu khwan e;
Abumaengc ryanraana puay tat bam hwan e.
3. Tingkauh kaidai khou ai guang tanghpui nungc kiu,
Tabui puat phungc guang ni Kakhang?
Aramneilaa na phungc guang ni Kapamv khou.
Nang mei khang laalou dat pw o,
Nang riw akhou tiikeylou dat ro.
Apumc lev abumaengc Nang khang tii the.
2. Ntaw thu ai Nang khang di the Poubauhmei.
Kros ruc khou thaengclou bam khoutei,
4. Tingsaeng Zion ramc tinggaancpatpui nungc kiu,
Tingkauh ramc khou guang dat lana,
Lu rui Nang ta thuanc ni Poubauhmei.
1. Kaipouc atuang paap puatrith kaguayna ti hei.
Ai rui huayneymei chulou o Poubauhmei.
Mik nic how mak ge ai ryanraamei ruina.
Mbaanv apanty heirui taniang guanh sihnic,
2. Apaap guay ta ningtow pwkhou ai ning ngammak.
Ai saa ngammak apaap guay ta.
Kaipouc Nang khang gaymei taanv tei,
3. Apanty khou neihlaa chuzaenghna lungc ethei,
Kaganv gaymei hei nai bam khou:
Ai rui phu e ringhmei chaeng tei,
O, maan ngam ni the bumaengh guay hei,
Chaeng maanvna bammei ta gulou o,
Tingsaeng ringhmei cham tei dincruanlou o.
1. Kaipouc Khrista tuang de nang bumaengc hei;
Bumaengh ta raina bam khang maek ge.
Khrista rui kaw bam the taw hei nang ta:
Ntaw Khrista khou nang guang la tho.
Rey khou taanhmei taanv taanc dat ri tho:
Kata nic thaengc kaluaihlou dat ri tho;
2. Kamei key dat pwni niw ta laa khang.
Taw lungh laih makmei kaguay tei mu,
Adih ryanraa ni cho heic ganv khou kiu!
Ryanraa pingmei rui kaphaan sw ni.
3. Kata lwmmei guay ta laathau pwni;
Paapc chaeng khou tat bammei zianmei guay le,

songs.title: Kaipouc Ravguangc rui Meic Kaguayna ta

lines: 116 Kaipouc Ravguangc rui Meic Kaguayna ta
1. Kaipouc Ravguangc rui meic kaguayna ta,
Nzianna kaw bam nzaenghmei khwan rui.
Ravguangc zauzian hei gay mbu haihhai,
Kaganv rui tatmei kumc gay mbu e.
Lwmsimei maekna Kataanv taanc bam ni,
Khamhpui nungc guangh pyrun run ni.
2. Zauclo, tay nimei lau tei minc bam the.
Tay nimei thu rau, lau thu daic bam e.
3. Ryanraa zaengsi nic, neihlaa zaenggay nic,
Kaganv thuih Jisu khou ai ngangvlou ni.
Paapc lev zinghmei khou lungc bammei guay khou,
Kros chuangphey tei daanc kauh bam ni.
4. 'Maan nimei bumaengc guay tei khuamguang khang,
He Kaipouc, pumtan tiikeylou na ro.
"Khamhpui tingmik nungc guangh bamvpaeng khou tei,
Seitaan tuang ngamv guay ta adow o;
Kahym daihmei khou ngammei sw o;
Rihngam khang huayney o ngam mak saanv.
Rihngam khang huayney o, huayney o.
Gaychamv lat rui nang phay khou louna,
3. Ringhbamv tuang rih pyrun run lana,
Adow o, he kros tuang ricmei guay.

songs.title: Kaipouc Saalou o Nang Bangc Ai tihei

lines: 118 Kaipouc, Saalou o Nang Bangc Ai tihei
1. Kaipouc, saalou o nang bangc ai tihei,
Tingsaengcna paapc rui zingc bam the;
Ringc nipui bamv maekmei kandih khouhei.
Gay nipui bamv maekmei kandih khouhei,
Neihlaa zaenggaymei kiu ni maek ge Pou'.
Nang lat gaymei tei aniu khang.
Neihlaa zaenggaymei guay tei aniu khang.
3. Kaipouc, saalou o aniu guay tihei.
Ringhpui bamv khou aniu ta zaylou o.

songs.title: Kakwm Kaganv hei Chakna Lungc o

lines: 119 Kakwm Kaganv hei Chakna Lungc o
1. Kakwm kaganv hei chakna lungc o he nzianmei nunc;
Lwmlouna nang mik rak pat ro;
Khudamc guay rui nchin bam the.
Nyan la ri tho, nzianmei nunc;
Thay pw lak khe mi ganv khou kiu.
gaanchuangcna guay ta nic zauc lo:
Lwmlouna nang mik tei hu thangc
Zauc pat ro, guang zaic pwni the.
3. Zauc lo, tadut bang tei nic kazik kasat pat pw the;
Tinglwm ganv tei'naa guang pw the.
Rih sw khang chamdaanv luai ngam the.
4. Zauclo, Noah lev Lot kaanc khou pat kanmei tei kumcna,
Aniw khou nic guang pwni the.
Thow rui tat ni, thow rui bam ni?
Chamdaanv la th0, 'naa guang pw the.
'Tamv suang khang kaganv rui guang the,
Guang dat lak khe panty hei.
Neih khat ganclou ducna tat pwni.
'Zianmei guay tat rey kanmei guay ta,
Lili puanghpui ramc khou khwan bam e.
2. Ning zauc lo, tuai nimei mwnpwang,
"Tamv suang khang kaganv rui guang the;
Kalum di kho Pou' Jisu ta,
Thuancku di kho Pou' Jisu ta.
Ata gulou khangrui guang the kandih khou.
1. Cross ruc khou zei rui apaap kuaklouna
Nang bumaengc ta nic swthanlou pwni.
2. Gutlou tho nang aseic Poubauhmei khou
Nang bumaengc tei katuang tiswlou o,
3. Poubauhmei Jisu guang dat pwni the,
Aram lum hei kalaic dat zat lak khe
4. Ai hei tingsaeng zaengna bam pwni the.
1. Kandih apanty hei luaina tatpui nungc kiu,
Samc kan ni the aPoucbauhmei ata zaylou na ro.
Heic ramc thangc tei theihmei ntammei nai lak khe.
Heic ramc gaymei thangc tei nzwanna tat dikho.
Kandih ryanraa kappui ramc khou rui ata zaylou o.
Chwnsi ryanraapui kandic khou bam saengc lakkhe.
2. Tingzyn neih khyamkey the zingckey kan pwni the.
Nei riw gaanhmei tei nai pwlak khe,
Tingkwm chanei Seitaan lev guanghtuna lungc pwkhou kiu,
Saa ngammakmei ryanraa pingmei guang pwni the.
3. Tingkauh gaanchuangcna rui gaanhbampui ramc thangc tei,
Ata zaylou o heic ramc thangc tei.
Zianmei alauc guay rui Zion ramc thangc nuic rimhrim bam,
Pou' Jisu rui chamdaanvloupui ramc khou.
He tabui nungc guang ni cho?
Kalaan ramc gay khou guang lungh khang:
Kalaan ny, zingbangc ny, laukhwan ni cho?
4. Paapc rui muangh kumcna zinghmei dic -
Ringhmei thingbang lim khou ai zaengswna,
Samctat kan ni the akai thangc.
Lauziu nac rui gaancna bampui ramc,
Theihmei mikdui keymei nai dat lak khe,
Samctat kan ni the heic khoutei.
Heic nungc kiu adih gay ni cho?
Eden ramc gay khou thuanc bam ni,
Khoutei guang khang khwan ngammak khe.
Nang zei rui nang bumaengh liu ni,
Mitei nang khaeng ngam pwni cho?

songs.title: Kandihmei guay Ringc dat diuc khang

lines: 126 Kandihmei guay Ringc dat diu khang
1. Kandihmei guay ringc dat diu khang,
Cross ruc khou Kamei theiclou the.
Thow pwnic Kakhou lwm makmei guai,
Latlumei lev ryanraamei ramc khou bam pwni.
Tabui nungc rui guangtangc ni cho?
Tabui nungc rui guangtangc ni cho?
Poubauhmei mu tingsaeng tingsaeng tuai dat lak khe.
3. Heicdi gaymei ramc tei laa khang,
Heic kandic hei ryanraa guang sihnic,
Nang zauzian rui ryanraamei guay ta ngam ni.
Poubauhmei ta zauc ngammakna kap pwni.

songs.title: Kandihmei Guay hei Paapc khou 'Maan the

lines: 127 Kandih Mei Guay Hei Paapc khou 'Maan the
1. Kandih mei guay hei paapc khou 'maan the;
Jisu rui kaw e Akhou guang o;
Akhou guangmei ta Ai 'patlou lak ge;
Thay ngam mak ge, saa ngam mak ge;
Dinc ngam mak ge, saa suak ngam lak;
2. Ryanraamei guay tei nang khang akhang,
Karam ryanraa thow saa ngam ni cho!
Akumhna nang khang akhang Jisu theic,
Paapc ric ta ngamna thau dat kan the.
3. Mousi kaanc khou pat kanmei kumcna.
Taudaic dui tei zangvna ringc kan the.
Ntaw thu taudaic kiu Jisu hei e:
T'rimei guay Akhou guang zangy kan diuc.
Kaganv maek khe lungh laic la tho:
Paapc phunghmei nunc khang theiclou the.
Heic tei rui aniw paap kuaklou.
3. Nang khang akhang e kaguay tei;
Lwmlou la tho nwan phunghmei guay;
Saa ngam mak ge karamzian tei.
Zinghmei hei guang khithkhit bam the.
Ramh ningtow makna lungc bammei guay,
Lunghlaic la tho kaganv naibam khouhei.
Jisu rui nang ta khwan bam the.
Tingkauhramc khou gut ngam lak ge.
Jisu khou nang guanglou la tho.
Kamei rui nang ta kadanlou pwni.
Nang panty nic tatna bam e.
Jisu khou nang bam tanhtan ethei,
Siimei rui aniw ta ngam dat lak khe.
Zaylou o, Nang baan zat rui.
Jisu rui aniw khou saa e:

songs.title: Kandih hei Zingbangc Kumc Zingcguang the

lines: 131 Kandih Hei Zingbangc Kumc Zingc Guang The
1. Kandih hei zingbangc kumc zingc guang the, a Poubauhmei
Kabamv kathuihna khou zauc pw ki,
Zingc guang the, 'dih ryanraa ramc khou hei,
Tabui nungc tingkauh khou neihlaana guang tangc ni cho?
Tingsaeng mbaanv thaypui ramc khou tei,
'Chu-nzaenghmei kaidai neihlaa suangmei ramc khou tei,
Guang tangh khang ai nkhwan lian lak khe !
2. Tabui thangc paklouna tabui thangc duplou ni cho ?
Ai duplou nipui bam Nang na de;
Zingbangc ny, kalaan ny Poubauhmei nang guang pw khou,
3. Tingkauh kandic khoutei, ringhmei thingbang lim khou tei,
Nthanmei alauc nunc guay tei rui,
Ravguangc ta thuanckuna neihlaana lu suan bam e,
Ravguangc hym daic kan diuc, Hallelujah !
4. Poubauhmei Jisu rui kasiamhloumei tingkauh ramc
Maansei mwang nà rui saa ngam mak ge;
Kakandic khou thingbang guay tei nic kariw tii e,
Mphuaic guay tei ni kariw tii e.

songs.title: Kindih hei Theihmei lev Paapc rui Chakin Swna

lines: 132 Kandih Hei Theihmei Lev Paapc rui Chakin
1. Kandih hei theihmei lev paapc rui chakin swna,
Lungcgay chingkhiuh, kai gay saamh gay khang akhyamna,
Kandih pwang kiu puangc thau pw the.
2. Makumh pwki kaikhunh swna lungc bam sinic,
Neihlaana tu-zangy kariuna lungc bam sinic,
Lwm mak ge thei ntamv pwni.
3. Tingkauh thangc khang rui taanv taanclou mak ge thei mu,
Heic kandic tuang neihlaamei chakin charin rui,
Tingkauh ramc khou gut ngam mak ge.
4. Ringhmei latchamv saa thayna dinc tat bam sinic,
Ramhkhe swmei, liantimei lungning khwan e thei,
Bumaengh ringhbamv laa ngam lak ge.

songs.title: Kandih hei Zingc Ranv Khithkhit Guang Pwthe

lines: 133 Kandih Hei Zingc Ranv Khithkhit Guang Pwthe
1. Kandih hei zingc ranv khithkhit guang pwthe;
Kabamv kathuih zingc guang pw the.
Zinghmei bamv khou theic kan nimei guay ta,
Zay kaanlou khang thow tat patlou ni cho?
Thau tho, thau tho, nzianmei guay thiu le;
Nang khang kaganv ri changh kan pwni the.
Nang panty hei paapc tuang duidai rui nzuan pwni.
2. Kandih chakin rui puangc bammei kandic,
Kalatryan tei lwm makmei sw la rio.
Ryanraa ryanriu daihmei guang pwni the.
Bumaengh guay ta phungc tat ngam kan ni the.
Ning zauc lo, kandihmei nzianmei guay.
4. Paapc zeic khou zaekna bammei bumaengc guay,
Nking lo, Gaychamv kaeng khwan tei.
Chyng lev nzaengc kabamv kathuih khou rui,
Gaychamv kaeng khwan kagaengv bammei chu lo.

songs.title: Kandih Hymdaih ta ai Phubam khou

lines: 134 Kandih Hymdaih ta ai Phubam Khou
1. Kandih hymdaih ta ai phubam khou,
Chaeng maanvmei nang ngalanc dat ro.
Poubauhmei hamhna ai neihlaa khang maek,
Chaengmaanv khou thow ata zaylou ni?
Kaipouc nang hamhna neihlaa khang maek.
Nang zauzian rui ai mbaanvthay the.
Kandih chwn ta ai amuc kan' the.
Apanty hei nang khou tiilou the.
Ata laa o Kaipouc Nang taanv khang.
4. Taw kandih puat guay ta karaeng the.
Kaipou, Nang tuang ringhmei chamv na ta,
Lu rui thuanc bam ni apanty khou.

songs.title: Kandih khou Kanyng Swna Bammei guay thiu

lines: 135 Kandih khou Kanyng Swna Bammei Guay thiu
1. Kandih khou kanyng swna bammei guay thiu,
Tabui nganvna nang nyng sw lana,
Ruan tat bam nina cho nzianmei guay le.
Kauc key khang chaengmun khou ding 'khwan bam the.
Theihmei chaeng khou ruan tat bammei guay,
Kaganv maek khe, Kaipouc rui kauc bam e.
'Dihmei guay khang kaganv ri pwni the.
2. Kaganv nai di he twna ning bammei guay,
Kaganv hei samc tat bam, 'thaekc makna.
Kaganv nai bam khou hei gay taanv taanc la tho.
Nang ta kaganv rui nkhwan pw lak khe.
3. Khrista rui nzianna kauc keymei khwan tei,
Chumei guay adih san gay ni cho!
Nthei thangc thu nang ta kaw dat pw lak khe.
Kaipouc khwan tei nang chu dat pw lak khe.
4. Kaipouc rui trampet amuan key zaic ni khou,
Ravsic rui simei taanv taanc diu khang,
Nthiam pwni the nangniw 'dihmei guay ta.
Mi kiu asaanh mak khou guang pwni the.
Karin gayna puangcpatmei mwn kumc e.
Neihkhat thu hei guay tuaina 'kamvkey the.
Mitei kumh tuang maansei 'niw panty hei.
Ning ngammakmei kaganv tei guang pwni,
Theihmei rui laytangh mak khou hanguang tho.
Gaymei nic siimei nic tat kan the.
'Muc kan the duipui mbaanv kandic khou,
Latzan khang na rui ringcthau dat khang di the.
3. Khrista khou theic kanmei kaguay tei,
Neihlaamei dam laa 'chamc khang ringcthau ni.
Kaniw ta ariu pwni neihkhat mu,
Gaanc gaymei laukhwan pat pwkhou ariu ni.
137 Kandih Khouhei Ai Lungc Nii mak
2. Kandih khou ai lungc niimak ge,
Jisu na de lungh neihlaa khang,
Akhang sw ni the Ravguangc hei.
3. Alung rui Nang ta thuanc bam ni,
He Ravguangc ai Nang khang sw ni;
Gu'meipu rui kaw e, 'zianmei khwan rui
'Dih neihlaa' patlouna ai ringc dat the,
Tingkauh kandic neihlaa' akhang di the.
Zaengthaekcpui bam maek ge, Khrista hamhna,
A puatrith guay Ka khou ganclou ngam the,
Lungh ryanraana bam khang kage maek khe.
3. A panty hei nang khang tiipatlou the,
Paapc rui zinghmei bamv khou lungcbammei nunc,
Nang riw gaanhmei bam khou gut dat nuh khang.
Nang rui ningmei guay tei titaanclou o,
Nang zauzian ta thayna ai lungcbam ni,
Tingkauh kandic akai guangtangh mak saanv.
Ravguangc khang lungcgaylou mak gethei mu,
Heic kandic tuang lungcgaymei guay mu,
'Maan ngam kan nimei maikhou kumh tuang de.
Nang lev akhang dinc ruanna bam e.
Lwmlou lana kalat dinc ruan di kho.
2. Ramh guayna thayna nyngtyng bam khwan sihnic,
Ravguangc ta thay makna lunghmei guay mu,
Nyngtyng rui tingkauh tangc ngammak ge;
Jisu ta lwmloumei na rui tat ni.
3. Kandih nyngtyng rui tingkauh tangc ngammak ge.
Kandih nyngtyng ramh khat sihnic hamh e;
Jisu hym daicna keypui nungc kiu,
Maansei nyngtyng guay hei 'maan ngam pwni.

songs.title: Kandih khou hei Pian Makmei ley

lines: Nzianmei rui heic guay tihei swmaan ngam e.
Nzianmei rui heic guay ti hei swmaan ngam e.
Gaanhmei riw ta hownii bam e.
Khrista ramgai lungc lyan ngam khang,
Chalumc siimei mamavmei lung 'maan ngam pwni.
Khat khat ta nzian nina de.
Nzianmei rui simei guay ta timaan ngam e.
Aniw tihei kanac nunc twna kawlou the.
Nzianmei rui hei guay tihei swmaan ngam e.

songs.title: Kandih Khouhei Pumh Gayna Lungcbam Saanv

lines: 1. Kandih khouhei pumh gayna lungcbam saanv,
Tat duc kan the, tat duc kan the.
He baanhzaap bam e, baanhzaap bam e.
Paapcmei nunc ta kawna bam e.
2. Diw siimei guay Ravguangc ta ningtow e.
Ngaengv hiwna kap e, ryanraamei guay.
Thiusaengc zayna Nang ta zauc e.
3. Alauc guay rui ringhmei chaeng thay mak ge.
Chaeng dinclou na ro, he Poubauhmei;
Amaan ngam kan nimei raana de.
Akhou guang o, paapc kuaklou ni;
Ningngam thuy pwlak khe 'thei thangc mu.
Kadan o, nang bumaengc 'maan mak khang.
Paapc rui bumaengh swmaan tuang e;
Paapc kuak ge thei bumaengh ringc ni.
Kandih puat guay nang tuang sw sihnic,
1. Kandih khou patbammei ramh kataana hei,
Ravguangc rui tỉiloumei ganv khou patbam tu e.
Puanhpui ganv nai e, theihpui ganv nai e;
Lingckeypui ganv nai, phuaiganhpui ganv nai e.
2. Swluaipui ganv nai , swgaypui ganv nai e;
Raakeypui ganv nai, kasiamhthaupui ganv nai;
Kappui ganv nai e, nuihpui ganv nai e:
Zaengsipui ganv nai, alaamhpui ganv nai e.
3. 'Dat ganhpui ganv nai, khuaic kaduaipui ganv nai;
Pamhpui ganv nai e, "patloupui ganv nai e;
Laaloupui ganv nai, amaanpui ganv nai;
Siatkaekpui ganv nai, hui kariupui ganv nai.
4. Reihreipui ganv nai, lat saapui ganv nai e;
Nzianpui ganv nai, karaengpui ganv nai e;
Ndaapcpui ganv nai, nggupui ganv nai;
Zinghpui ganv nai e, gaanc datpui ganv nai e.
5. Ramh kaguay Ravguangc ruina taanclou ngam e;
Simei ryanraamei guang pwkhou huayney o;
Ramh gaymei guay guang pwkhou thuancku o;
Ravguangc rui ngam lak tuang khatsihnic maek ge.
Kuaklou na ro, akhuay guay tei.
Kauc ruan bam ni kandih khou hei.
Ai sinsw the mbaanv puat guay;
Kuaklou na ro akhuay guay hei.
Ganckey ni the mbaanv puat guay;
Nang khang ruina sinsw ni the:
Kuaklou na ro, akhuay guay hei.

songs.title: Kandih Panty Gaymei Tat Twan Pwni the

lines: 146 Kandih Panty Gaymei Tattwan Pwni the
1. Kandih panty gaymei tattwan pwni the;
Ravguangc, Nang rui zaylou gaeklou o;
Nang zauzian rui ata zaykaanlou o.
Jisu rui kros khou ryanraa khaengvlou.
Kandih ramgai ai phu dat lak khe;
Tingsaeng zaeng kanloumei ta phu ni;
2. Siimei duithuak khourui zaykaan patlou o;
Jisu tuang kros hei phungc ngam diu khang,
Nang zauzian rui ata zaykaanlou o.
3. Ai ringhmei panty t'rou khourui thau lana,
Gaanc guang o Poubauhmei, ai chaeng maanv the.
Tat nipui bamv akhat nai e.
