songs.title: Kandih Paap Guay Phungc diuc khang

lines: 148 Kandih Paap Guay Phungc Diuc khang
1. Kandih paap guay phungc diuc khang,
Kata thay makpui bamv kathuih khou,
2. Nang lev aniw meic guay ta,
Poubauhmei Ravguangc ta laalou diu khang,
Phaengc zauc lana nang nzian makna cho?
Duakpat diu khang tat di kho.

songs.title: Kandih Paapc rui Zingc the APoubauhmei

lines: 1. Kandih paap rui zingc the aPoubauhmei,
Ai Nang phay bangc khou gulou khang guang e.
2. Neihlaamei maek ge heic kandic khouhei,
Nang ramgai ta how khang Nang khou guang e.
3. Heic saan Nang khourui maengtat khwan sihnic,
Nang khwan chuna ai rui ngalancguang e.
Nang ramc tangh khang paapc ric ta adow ni.
Chamdaanv bam makpui mei guay mu,
Kaipouc ta ariu ngam lak ge.
2. Ringhmei Latchamv chu nii bam sihnic,
Chu tow dat pwlak khe 'thei thangc.
Kaipouc rui nang ta kaw sihnic,
Kaw bammei khwan chu dat lak khe.
3. Nang rui puihuayna kauc bam sihnic,
Nang huay bammei nsaa di the.
Nang ta latzan swpui nungc kiu,
4. Bumaengh guay rui kapna kaucbam e;
Zinghmei chaeng khou gut ngam kan the;
Heic tei theihmei maikhunc chaeng e.
5. Guang tho twna Kaipouc rui kaw e.
Latzan tingmik tei guang tuanc the:
Ravguangc khang rui kaikhamv laancpat di kho:
Ningngam thuy pwlak khe 'thei thangc mu.
Kaikhunhmei guay lev neihlaa nchamc khang,
Poubauhmei khou lwmlou bam di kho.
2. Poubauhmei rui kros ruc khou theiclou the;
Aniw paap guay ta swthanlou the.
Kazei kunghmei rui ata liulou the,
3. Poubauhmei Khrista keypui nungc kiu mu,
Ravguangc guangcdic hei naaguang changh pwthe,
Lwm la tho twna Pou' rui saa e.
1. Kandihramc khou ryanraana bumaengh khuammei thiu !
Zingh makpui ramc khou tei lungc ni.
Paapc kaguayna nai dat lak khe.
2. Tingkauhramc khou ch'rynmei ramgai kaguayna tei,
'Niw nic mi ramc khoutei lungc ni.
3. Tingkauh ramgai khou lwmloumei kaguayna tei,

songs.title: Kandih Ramgai hei Luai kan Pwni the

lines: 153     Kandih ramgai hei luai kan pwni the
1. Kandih ramgai hei luai kan pwni the,
Tingkauh neih thanh tei pat pwni the.
'Kauh Jubilee tuang trampet muan ni the,
Lwmmei guay khoutei guang pwni the.
Mikdui rau ntamvmei nai lak khe.
Kandi ramsi ta ning dat lak khe.
2. Pou' ta lwmlou changh makmei guay mu,
'Kauhramc gay' khoutei guang ngam pwlak khe.
Tingsaeng zaeng ryanraamei khou lungc ni.
Salem lu suanna Pou' ta thuanc bam ni,
Khat rui khat ta 'zianna lungc o.
Simei taanv guay mpat la tho.
Ntwnmei guay ruc khou nai e.
Kandih chwn guay mpat la tho.
Gaymei taanv rui ngammei sw o.
Khat rui khat ta nzian makna,
Mik rui how makmei Ravguangc ta
1. Kanloumeipu khou rui ruantat 'maan khwan sihnic.
Kaguangcdic gay khou lungh khang kabaanc rui zaylou.
He Poubauhmei Nang rui ata 'zianmei thay the:
Nang baanzat rui zaylou o Poubauhmei:
Nang ramc gay khou lungh khang
2. 'Dihmei guay rui thay lakmei ryanraamei khourui,
Ravguangc ta thuanhpui lu taek makna suan bam ni.
3. Jordan duidai tei kaan ngammak aPoubauhmei.
Tanhmei Nang baanc rui ata zaylou o;
Tingsaeng guangcdic khou ata duanghlou o.
Nang guangcbamv hu khou ping tuang maekna thuanc bam ni.
4. Ntaw kaganv gay khou Khrista ta laalou tho;
Chabwan panty Khrista rui laanii e:
Nang guangcdic hei anaa guang pwkhou kiu,
Nang khou bam makmei guay adih sansii ni cho.

songs.title: Kapu tuang Suaihiam tei Ganclou Duc Lana

lines: 1. Kapu tuang suaihiam tei ganclouduc lana,
Chaeng maanvna ruan amaan tat kanmei nac kumc,
Kandih lunggai ta kamei rui phu khwan e.
Kachangcmei khou rui 'bui thangc ruantat tu cho?
'Kai khou hanguang dat ro' twna kaw e;
Zion khang rui thow taanv taanclou ni cho?
Poubauhmei taanv taanc diu khang, Nang ta kaw bam the.
2. Ruan 'maan kanmei nac kumc tatmaan ngam kan the.
kadyng maekmei kandih lunggai ta phuna,
Ramhkhe swmei nyngraeng swmei khou lungcna;
Nang Pu 'zinamei khourui nang ruantat ni cho?
3. Poubauhmei rui kaw khou nang guang zihna cho?
Neihlaa suang khang hamh e maengtatmei chaeng khou,
Nang Pu nzianmei rui nang ta kaw bam the,
Zauzian chaengmun laanclou bam khou guang la tho.
Kalaanv zingbangc nai dat lak khe,
Ndaapc tarimei nai dat lak khe:
Bw, neih, gaanchuangc riw nsaa de;
Lauziu Nac rui gaanc e hei khoutei.
Theihmei suhmei nai dat lak khe.
Nai lak khe Nang guangcdic gay khoutei.
Nai lak he Nang guangcdic gay khoutei.
Guang tho theicloumei cross khou ringhmei nai.
Cross ruc khou t'rina kauc bam e.
Heic guay hei nang aniw zaeng khangrui e.
2. Karam zian hei adih daic cho?
Ruak naipui kamv nang zanc ta thuanc ni;
Zianloumeipu nang ta tingsaeng thuanc ni.
Adih zianlou tu cho saa ngammak ge.
Rac tangc thuy lak karamzian tei:
Neih key dat makpui ramc tei;
Bumaengh guay guang lungc nipui ramc e;
Guang tangc pwni neih khat ai.
Zaion ramgai ta machunh e aPoubauhmei;
He Poubauhmei Jisu ata zay thaulou o.
Kachaekc kaidai gaymei ramc khou tei,
Samc tat pwni neih khat ai.
Zinghmei tei guang zaic pwni the;
Paapc kandic tei twan pwkhou kiu,
Heic kandic ta ning dat lak khe.
3. Kaipouc tuang tingmik guang mak khou,
Kaganv rui nai bammei lungc khou;
Nang bumaengc ringh khang phu la tho.
Kaipouc tei guang zaic pwni the.
1. Khat khat ta nangniw 'zianna, Khat khat kungcna lungc o;
Khat khat ta kadan k'ry o; Aram kadanlou kumc,
Khat khat puat phungc 'khav k'ry o; Khat khat neihlaa 'chamc o;
Khat khat 'zianna lungc pwkhou, Aziap twna thay diu.
2. Khat khat ta kuaklou k'ry o; Ai rui kuakloumei kumc,
Khat khat khang huayneylou o; Aram huayneylou kumc,
Khat khat ta khavlou k'ry o; Khat khat siamruai sw o;
Taanclou tu laa niimei tei, Baihmei khou taanclou tio.
3. Nang ta zauczihmei nunc ta, Nang thu 'zian khangclou tio;
Simei taancloumei nunc khang, Suaihiam neylou lyn tio;
Nangniw hei kandih 'tey e; Nangniw kandih riw e;
Nangniw taanv gaymei tei rui Ravguangc hym lungc lyan tio.

songs.title: Khrista Guang dat Nimei Ganv tei

lines: 162 Khrista Guang dat nimei Ganv tei
1. Khrista guang dat nimei ganv tei,
Nthanmei panty khou lungcna bam o.
2. Zaatc khat rui zaatc akhat ruc khou,
Rih swmei chamv rana chu bam the;
Pat bammei khudam guay zauc lo,
Lwmlouna chamdaanv bam kan di kho.

songs.title: Khrista Key dat khang Kaganv 'Naa the

lines: 163 Khrista Key Dat Khang Kaganv 'Naa the
1. Khrista key dat khang kaganv 'naa the:
Kalat tei pheybaan swna piu o.
Katuang hamh e twna Khrista rui saa e:
Ruamc tachat tuang chakiu khou hy e.
Rapchar ganv khou kiu Kamei rui,
Kamei guay ta laa kan pwni the;
Ntaw Khrista ta laalou la tho.
2. Guangh guay Guangc Kaipouc guay 'pouc swna,
Key dat pwni the muangh ruc khourui.
Lungning dingna bam khou ny hamh khou ny cho?
3. Nthuanh kaganv nai pwng e ning rio;
Aseic twmei hei nang khang kiu the;
Ntaw hei nang ringcbamv lam thay tho;
Ntaw hei nang Khrista khang katpat la tho;
Ntaw Khrista ta laalou la tho.
Kakhourui tat duc haihhai tat the.
Zingh khou bammei bumaengc guay ta zauc lo,
Ai neihlaa ngam lak ge, he Poubauhmei,
Nang guangcdic khou guangpui nungc kiu.
Khat rui khat ta 'zianna pumh khat swna,
2 'Zianmei nunc le, lwmmei khou daicthau kho,
Nang rui thayloumei guay ngampat pwkhou,

songs.title: Khrista khou Puimei, Zemei Maek ge

lines: 166 Khrista khou Puimei, Zemei Maek ge
1. Khrista khou Puimei, Zeme maek ge;
Mi hei 'zianmei tuang phwam daih khat de;
Katuang taanv-ruai hei kachaekc riang e.
3. Lwmmei khou chanaa swmei thiu le !
Pu ta nah swna siamruai swmei,
Khrista luihmei guay khatna di the;
1. Khrista muangh ruc khou Kahym daicna key pwni.
Khrista muangh ruc khou Kahym daicna key pwni.
Kaganv tei saa ngammak lauthwan ny,
Khrista tei muangh ruc khou dungcna,
Jisu key the (Champanvthiu, nang chamdaanv thah?)
Key pwthe (Champanvthiu, Kamei lev tat khang)
Guanghtulou khang (Key pwni the muangh ruc khou)
Lauthwan ny, kalaan ny, zingbangc ny,
Khrista tei muangh ruc khou dungcna,
2. Khrista guang pwkhou paapc phunghmei kaguayna khang,
Ryanraa pingmei rui kadunh pwni hei khoutei;
Nang lung laic lana ding ntip tho.
Kaganv tei ri pwni, Kamei guangmei khang chamdaanv tho;
3. Khrista guang pwkhou lwmloumei kaguayna rui,
Neihlaa zaenggayna Kata sowriu pwni the;
He champanvthiu le, nang chamdaanv thah?
Hanguang dat tho twna kaw e;
Pou' Khrista hu khou lungc lyan o.
Zingckeymei hei nai dat lak khe;
Mikdui luanghmei nai dat lak khe.
Mikdui key dat makpui ramc khou.

songs.title: Khrista Zanc khou Nangniw Dwan-gaymei e

lines: 169 Khrista Zanc Khou Nangniw Dwan-gaymei e
1. Khrista zanc khou nangniw dwan-gaymei e;
Guang kariumei hei Khrista paan rui e;
Tingsaeng zaeng ringh khang kata lwmlou o;
Nangniw Ravguangc nac swmei adih kamv gay!
2. Nthuanh panty ta nang thay dina cho?
Khrista guang nimei kiu nang thayna cho?
Nthuanh twna saa khang kaganv maek khe;
Ntaw twmei hei nang khang kaganv di the.
3. Lungh laic nimei kaganv kiu guang pwthe;
Khrista guang nimei kiu nic 'naa guang the.
Lungh laic tho twna Khrista rui kaw bam;
Kamei key khang chaengmun khou dingna bam the.

songs.title: Khristian nunc ta Tiraimei Saul ta

lines: 170 Khristian Nunc ta Tiraimei Saul ta
1. Khristian nunc ta tiraimei Saul ta,
Ravguangc rui karuc khou latzan sw:
"Ai hei nang rai bammei Jisu tei e" twna daw the.
2. Mi tangv tei Saul tei Paul kaw kan the:
Thau lana namvdai thangctei tat tho;
Nang khuay guayna kuaklou ngam the;
Meic kaguay khou Gaichamv dinctat tho.
3. Heic tangvtei Paul tei lungh laic kan the;
Kamei rui railou kanmei guay khou,
Meic ching ching rui ringhbamv laa kan the.
4. Nthanmei Paul rui Gaichamv dinh khou,
Ruamc mei guangc Nero rui lunghpuamc the;
Baengsaeng rui kapy dangvtap kan the.

songs.title: Korinthia khou Paul rui Saa e

lines: 171 Korinthia khou Paul Rui Saa e
1. Korinthia khou Paul rui saa e:
Tii nina tii o Ravguangc khang.
Neihlaana tii o laa geih khang.
Tingsaeng zaeng ringhmei tei tiilou the.
Paapcmei ai kumhmei ta gulou the.
3. Tingkauh ramgai tei how kan diuc,
1. Lwmloumei Nouha rui chamdaanvmei tei zauc lo,
Paapc tuang duidai tei guang makpui hu khou;
Paapc tuang duidai tei kaan khang hih ruaic the.
Ntaw ganv khou nic thow kumhmei rui,
Chamdaanv tho Jisu guang makpui hu khou,
2. Poubauhmei Jisu guang pwkhou heic kandic hei,
Zy khou gaanv nei rui zipna bam pwni;
Lwm makmei ta ganclou ni heic khoutei.
3. Poubauhmei Jisu guang pwkhou heic kandic hei,
'Tumei gaanvnei rui nap riak bam pwni;
Lwmmakmei ta ganclou ni heic khoutei.
4. Poubauhmei Jisu guang pwkhou heic kandic hei,
Meic gaanvnei rui laupuk khou bam pwni;
Lwmmakmei ta ganclou ni heic khoutei.
5. Poubauhmei Jisu guang pwkhou heic kandic hei,
Mi ganv khou kiu kaikhunh ntam pwni.
Nangniw pumc lev nangniw bumaengc guay tei,
Ravguangc thuanhpui khwan rui padik ni;
Lwmloumei guay rui guang bam pwni;
Tingkauh ramneilaa zạenggai guay hei mu,
Tingsaeng zaeng kimkey dat lak khe.
Lungh khangtei tat di kho 'zianmei guay;
Lwmmei guay rui tat ri kan pwkhou kiu,
Zinghmei 'dic khou ai lungc nii mak:
Ringhmei thing lim khou zaengsw khang,
Zaylou o, Khrista Nang baanc rui.
Ai kaamcthau the tingkauh chaeng khou;
Zaylou o Khrista Nang baanc rui;
Tingkauh ramc khou zaeng 'thaekc ni the.
Panty luai mak khou zangv la tho;
Panty nai khou ringhmei laa tho.
Khrista key ni lwmmei guay khang,
Tingkauh ramc ta ai zauc bam;
Kamei nunc khang kadahpui nungc kiu,
Guang ding ni Ravguangc hu khou.
3. Nang mei khang kadah nungc kiu,
Nang mei nunc ta laa pwkhou,

songs.title: Lungh Ryanraamei rui Ata Duam Liamna

lines: 179 Lungh Ryanraamei rui Ata Duam Liam
1. Lungh ryanraamei rui ata duam liamna,
Pou' Jisu ta lwmlou makmei nunc khang,
Ringc nimei lev chwn gaymei maek ge.
Jisu guang pwkhou ai kap taan pwni;
Nkhwan ngammak ge Jisu guang nimei.
Kalwn how pwkhou ai neihlaa bam pwni;
Heicpui ganv khoutei ai kap dat lak khe.
2. Lungh ryanraamei lev kapmei padik the;
Tat reymei champanv guay phaengc bam e,
Tingsaeng ramgai khou lungc 'chamc diu khangrui,
Guangtangclou khang ai huayney bam e.
3. Kap dat lak khe Jisu keypui nungc kiu;
Lwmmei nunc mikdui key dat lak khe;
Tingkauh ramc gaymei khou guang lungc pwkhou,
Lwmloumei guay mu kap dat lak khe.
4. 'Maanmei nunc khang ai huayney ranv bam ni;
Theihmei bamv khou kapmei bamv khourui,
Muangh kumcha zingc e alung khou;
Mik rui howgaymei na ta phu;
Mpaeng khou gay, kalungc khou siimei nai.
Hei rui Nang ta tikim ngammak;
Ai ping lak khe Seitaan ric ta;
Nang khou guangna thuancku bam ni.
Apumtan guay Pou' Nang khang e.
Ngamv guay hei Nang zauzian paan e;
Nang na ta ai zaucna bam ni.
4. Swthanlou o Nang ta thuanh khang;
Ravguangc Chamv dinhmei hei na de.
Nang adih kamv nyan bam tu cho?
Nang ta maikwam khou raw pwni;
Nang ta latzan swpui nungc kiu,
Tabui lat nang daw ni cho?
1. 'Maan dat lakmei Poubauhmei ramc tei ning e;
Neihriw gaeng dat mak khe nthanmei rar tei;
Nang bumaengc khang nang pumc tii pat la tho.
Ntaw guang tho Kanloumeipu Guangh Khrista khou.
Bumaengh thuakloumei Guangh Khrista hu khou,
Ntaw nyan makna Kadaeng khou guang tho.
Gu'meipu ta ramh chak makmei guay mu,
Tingsaeng theihmei ryanraamei rui kaphaan sw ni.
Gutmei guay mu san-gaymei sw pwni;
Ntaw guang tho Kanloumeipu Guangh Khrista khou.
Kaganv gay khou lwmlou la tho:
Gu'meipu rui nang ta nkhwan banm the.
Ngalanc guang o, nang paap guay tei kuaklou pwni.
Meic pumc khang theihmei 'tay dat ni;
Bumaengh tingsaeng ringhmei tei laa pwni.
David paapc rui kahawmei taanh' rui,
Kanac mpouh khou theihmei pat the.
3. Kanac Mpouh ta lwm makmei mu,
Kanac Mpouh ta lwmmei tei mu,
Bumaengh tingsaeng ringhmei tei laa pwni.
1. Maansei lungning kathuih khou chwnsw pingmei rui,
Ravguangc khou niamh key tho ryanraa' guay phungclou khang;
Nthanpui chaeng khou Khristian guay thau tho.
Jisu key pwni the, zingbangc ny, kalaan ny,
Trampet khwan chu pwkhou kaniw guay tei,
Tat nimei tingkauh khou theihmei maek ge.
2. Kandih tuang neihlaa guay 'maan pwni kahu khou;
Ravguangc latdanv chu makmei guay tei nic.
Jisu key pwni the trampet khwan kazauhna,
Kapaap kuak'pui mei guay khoutei lungc ni.
3. Ryanraa' guay tei luaina tingsaeng zaeng neihlaa ni;
Tingkauh thangc tei aniw sowriu pwkhou.
Kandih ta 'tamvlouna 'kauh thangctei samc ku ni.
Ravguangc hym khoutei aniw zaeng 'thaekc ni.
King o, Ravguangc thanv bam e,
Ravguangc khou na nang lwm tho;
1. Baibal khou 'thanna nai e, Suai dat lakmei latryan tei.
Ngam lakmei twmei tihei, Kamei thu thay zat mak ge.
Aniw rui Kabiak liangcna, Kalat khou lwm changh pwkhou.
2. Ramh guay ngam tu raana de, Twmei hei Kalatryan e.
Nang lwm tho Kalatryan hei, Nang khang rui tiilou tu the.
Kalat hei suai zat mak ge, Twmei 'niw thanna thay e.
3. Ravguangc tuang latryan guay hei, Kachanh lakmei runghchei e.
'Liu ranvnå 'liuguang pwkhou, Kalatryan guay khou lwm tho;
Ravguangc thủ suai makmei e.Kamei rui 'niw ta damclou,
Kabaanc khou ramh guay nai e.
1. Matthiu chuihna panguh pary khou saalou e:
Bangh gaanvthumh khou Kaipouc rui talent nzanhlou.
Gaanvkhat khang panguh, gaanvkhat khangtei kanei,
"Ai tatna guang dat 'ni, nangniw taanv guay zauh khang;
Nzanhloumei khourui mbuna taanc bam o,"!
Twna Kaipouc rui meic kathuih khou dinclou.
2. Kaipouc rui guang datna talent tei khuamthau the.
Bangh gaanvnei khou tei Kaipouc rui kumna saa e:
"Ai rui tiiloumei taanv tei taanc chuy dyng the;
3. Bangh gaanvkhat khoutei Kaipouc rui kumna saa e:
"Ai rui tiimei taanv tei t'ui swna taanh mak cho!
Kaipouc rui Kalung puamcna mi lat saa e.
4. Ntaw kin khou nic Kaipouc rui kumna saa e.
Nang khou tiloumei taanv tei taanc zih bam tu ch0
Kaipouc guang pwkhou tabui lat daw ni cho?
Nang pumc kaguay tiipatna taanc o.

songs.title: Mbaanv hei Amaan khang Kaganv Naaguang the

lines: 1. Mbaanv hei amaan khang kaganv 'naaguang the;
Kaipouc rui nrianhlou tuang di the;
Gaanv khatna sihnic tikalaic ngam mak;
Chamdaanvna nkhwan bam khang na di the.
Kaipouc latryan guay tei kalaic dat pwlak khe;
Kalat piu makmei kandihmei guayna ta,
Latzan sw khangruina chaengmun khou ding bam the;
Latzan hu khourui duak dat ngam pwlak khe.
2. Theihmei paapc chaeng khou ruantat bammei guay tei,
Kaipouc rui nang ta 'zianna kaw e.
Kandih kabamv kathuih khou zingcguang the;
Gaanhmei tingkauh khou guang lungh khang kaw e.
3. Ringhmei Latchamv rui chyng 'zaengc kabamv thuih khou,
Nthw 'luanh rah kumc kagaengv lik the.
Nruay guay rui thingphaanv gay khou towna,
Thuancna suan bam e Ravguangc tuang hym ta.
4. Ntaw kaw bammei hei zianmei nang ta the;
Nang ruina aseic guang mak gethei,
Nthuanh thu nang kapna kauc bam sihnic,
Nang khang na rui han-guang dat ngam lak khe.
Charynpui tuang e mbaanv ramlung hei.
Ningna bam sihnic nzianmei guay ta;
2. Nzianmei guay le, charynpui tuang e,
Tingkauh ramgai tei nang howpui nungc kiu;
Kanganv nai lak khe tingkauh ramgai tei,
Mwang rui saa ngam lakmei ramgai.
3. Tingkauh ramgai suangc mbaanv ramgai ta,
Ningkunghmei guay khou Rav syang key pwni;
Ravguangc taanv ta sinnui bammei guay tei,
4. Bumaengh taanv suangc kandih taanv 'tynmei guay
Tingkauh ramc khoutei nang khang bamv maek khe.
Nthei thangc nang huayna kap bam sihnic,
Nsaa di the, nang khang hamh the.

songs.title: Mbaanv Ramgai khou Lungc Bammei Guay

lines: 190 Mbaanv Ramgai Khou Lungc Bammei Guay
1. Mbaanv ramgai khou lungc bammei guay,
Amaan pwni the kandih guay hei.
Poubauhmei hu khou aniw ding pwkhou,
Latzan sw pwni zaatc guayna ta;
Kandih ramgai guay ganclou duc ni.
Simei rui 'thiam bam kaganv thuih khou;
Kum sihnic Pou' rui duanghlou pwni.
Kaipouc khou lwmloumei guay khang mu,
Timaan lak ge twna dinclou e.
4. 'Taw kandih puat guay ganclou duc ni,
Poubauhmei Nang ringhmei lat guay tei,
Panty nai bam saanv suanna bam ni.

songs.title: Meic Kyam Phungh Makmei Ravguangc Lauziu

lines: 1. Meic kyam phungh makmei Ravguangc Lauziu Nac!
Ravguangc bamvpaeng khou tei zinghmei maek ge;
Ravguangc ta tingsaeng thuancna lungc bam pwni the.
Nthanmei nunc lev tat 'chamc bam ni,
2. Poubauhmei tuang muhzwng Bumaengh paan rui,
Ramh guayna guang nimei ndauhlou e,
Heic latchamv piumei guay tei kasan gaymei e.
3. Kaganv hei katumcna guang pwni the;
Taanv siina taanhmei tei taanc bam kan diuc;
Nkhwan bam o, Ai katumcna guang pwni the.

songs.title: Mi Kandic hei Akai Hamh e

lines: 192 Mi Kandic hei Akai Hamh e
1. Mi kandic hei akai hamh e,
Kandih ramgai hei mu atuang hamh e,
Alanv guay lou ducna ai tat pwni.
'Patlou duc ni mi ramc hei mu.
3. Tingkauh akai tangh pui nungc kiu,

songs.title: Mpatlou tho Nang Kandih Champanv guay ta

lines: 1. Mpatlou tho nang kandih champanv guay ta;
Ntamv mak gethei kaganv neihmik key' pwni.
Nang khang kaganv neihpat dat mak;
Nang guang la tho katumc la tho.
Aseic guang makmei guay khou mu,
2. David tuang kaikhamv laanc bammei ganv khouhei,
Kandihmei rui mbangh ngam mak, mi kaikhamv tei.
'Bangh kan ethei laanc dat ngam mak,
3. Nrih hei thingbang kathuihna khou nai e.
Nthai makmei bang guay tei mu gay ganc pwni.
1. Mphwanmei guangh bamvpaeng khou dungc lana,
Nkhuaimei guay Kahu khou ding ngammak;
Nang guang ding ngam ni cho khoutei;
Jisu rui kandih hei luaipui nungc kiu,
2. Kandih khou gay makmei taancloumei guay,
Ramh khat sihnic nkamhlou ngam mak ge,
3. Ringhmei Latrik tei phaekpatpui nungc kiu,
Kaipouc rui maikwam khou phaiclou pwni;
1. Nang Jisu ta how khang chamdaanvna bam o (3)
Aseic Kakhwan chu the, lungning tanh ritho.
2. Jisu hei chaeng e, 'chumhmei lev ringhmei e (3)
Aseic Kakhwan chu the, lungning tanh ritho.
3. Tingsaeng zaeng ringhmei panty nang laa la tho (3)
Aseic Kakhwan chu the, lungning tanh ritho.
4. Ravmaengc kalummei khourui nang tatpat tho (3)
Aseic Kakhwan chu the, lungning tanh ritho.
Nang taanv gåymei rui lungc lyan o,
Taanv rui lwmmei tei ndauhpat ro.
Tiiloumei kaipat tei taanc chuy o.
Ringhmei chamv tei dinctat la tho.
Thei hanna bammei bumaengc guay ta,
Khrista rui kaw e lunghlaicguang khang.
Kaipouc rui zauh khang guang pwni.
Nang rui taanc chuyna taanclou ethei,
Kaipouc rui swan tei tiilou pwni.

songs.title: Nang Phaan Khrista rui Key' Theiclou

lines: 197 Nang Phaan Khrista rui Key' Theiclou
1. Nang phaan Khrista rui key' theiclou:
Kandih khou aniw panty hei mu,
Tat kanmei ganv tei han dat ngammak.
Latdanv guay tei piu makmei mu,
Nang apaap zaeng khang dyng the.

songs.title: Nang Ringc Bam khou Gaytaanv Taanc

lines: 198 Nang Ringc Bam khou Gaytaanv Taanc o
1. Nang ringc bam khou gaytaanv taanc o;
Kaganv maek khe katumc la tho.
Thei han datna bammei guay thiu le,
Nang hu thangc zauc pat dat ro;
Nang hu khou cross ding bam e;
Nang khang aseic hei di the,
3. Aseic nang tuang e nthuanh thu
Ravguangc tuang di the zianmei nunc.
Nang paap tei haengc bam sihnic,
4. Kaganv 'twan mak khou guang la tho,
1. Nazarethmeipu Jisu lwn ta nang how tha ?
Kata howmei guay rui lungh neihlaa e.
AGuangc Jisu hei gay liang e;
Akhang mu Poubauhmei hei gay liang e.
2. Paapc phunghmei guay rui guang lana Kata how the.
Kazaw paanv tei neihmik khangsuangc gaanc e.
Laalou diu khang ai rui huay e.
3. Patmos pwkak khou Jahuan rui Jisu ta how the;
Kazaw paanv tei neihmik khangsuangc gaanc e.
4. Kandih khou lungcsi ryanraa padik guang sihnic,
Nangniw rui lungh khang bamv chamdaanvlou the.
Neihlaamei tei kim dat lak khe;
Thau lana dinc tat lak na cho?

songs.title: Nang ta Kaw e Zauzian Khywan ru

lines: 201 Nang ta Kaw e Zauzian Khwan rui
1. Nang ta kawe zauzian khwan rui,
Paapc phunghmei nac akhwan chu tho:
2. Heic kandic hei akai hamh e,
Tingkauh klai ta nkhwan lian lak.
3. Ai kaamcthau the tingkauh chaeng khou,
Cross khou paapc guay khiu 'thanlou the.

songs.title: Nang Tuang Paapc Puat hei Ganclouna

lines: 202 Nang tuang Paapc Puat hei Ganclouna
1. Nang tuang paap puat hei ganclouna,
Ravguangc hym ta thuancna bam ni,
Jisu pamv khou ai tat ni,
Jisu ta ai how ni the.
Kamei nunc ta laa thau ni:

songs.title: Neihkhat Jisu rui Zaatc Guay ta

lines: 204 Neihkhat Jisu rui Zaatc Guay ta
1. Neihkhat Jisu rui zaatc guay ta khuam kariu ni;
Meic gaymei lev meic siimei ta kadaa pwni,
Gaanv saekc ta gay e twna saapui kaanc khou kiu,
Mi nunc guay pangc khou tei nang kazauh pwni cho?
Lwmloumei nunc rui ringhmei dui tei zangv pwkhou,
Lwmmakmei nunc rui tarina dui ney pwni.
2. Kaganv tangc pwkhou kiu ai tat ni tingkauh thangc;
Kandih khou taancloumei swan tei ai laa pwni;
Lwmloumei guay rui ringhmei pyrun run pwni.
Mi nunc guay pangc khou tei nang kazauh pwni cho?
3. Poubauhmei latzan tingmik neihkhat guang pwni;
'Rianhloumei ganv tei ai leyduak ngam pwlak khe.
Gaanvsaekc rui maikwam khou tat nipui kaanc khoutei;
Mi nunc guay pangc khou tei nang kazauh pwni cho?
4. Kakhuay maekmei Ravguangc Nac Jisu theihmei tei,
Paapc phunghmei akhang e twna ai laalou the.
Guloumei guay ta khuam kariu ni tingkauh khou;
Mi nunc pangc khou tei ai nic kazauh pwni the.
1. Neihkhat tingmik thu 'niw pumc hei taniang 'guanh pwni;
Heipui nungc kiu nang bumaengc ringc ngam ni cho?
Ravguangc hu khou karaa raana guang ding
Aniw taanv guay saa 'dauh dat khang
Khou kiu nang paapc phungc lana
Nang t'ui lat daw ni cho Poubauhmei hu khou!
2. Nang khang nyan langv pwnge kandihmei
Nang ta laaloumei ganv tei tat 'twan pwni.
Daihmei 'thyammei guay ta latzan sw pwni.
Bw neih gaanchuangcna gay ta samcrina.
Tingkauh lwn khou gwanlihna samctat ni.
Neihlaamei kim dat makna lungc bam ni
Ning dat lak khe kandih ryanraa ramc ta
Tingkauh baancharaa guay lev neihlaa 'cham ni.
2. Kandih hei mu ryanraapui ramc e,
Tingsaeng lungc suang lak nipui ramc de,
'Patlou ducna ai tat khap kan ni the.
Tingmik kathuih rysnraamei rui duam liam.
Paapc mwnpwang rui puangc ariupui ramc,
Zaylou o Pou' nang baanc rui tingkauh khou.
Tingkauh kandic how niimei guay, Puancthanh la tho.
Tingkauh kandic guang niimei guay, Puancthanh la tho.
2. Nkhamh liangmei ganv kiu guang the;
Nang rui paapc taanclou khwan ethei,
4. Zanh khourui puanhmei tei zanh e:
Paapc ric ngamna guangmei guay khang
Neihlaa lu rui Ravguangc ta thuancna
Tingkauh mei guay suan bammei lu tei -
2. Daihmei thyammei nai dat lak khe,
Lungcgai lungsi nai dat lak khe,
Zauczih karaengmei nai dat lak khe.
Ntamvmei lwn nic how dat lak khe.
Ningtow dat lak khe, how dat lak khe.
Gaanc kangvranmei riw rui gaanc e,
Tingsaeng zaeng lungc nipui namvdai tei.
1. Neihlaa daihmei ramc tei guang khang duh mak khe:
2. Paapc chaeng khou tatmei khang ryanraa zaic ni the;
Chulou o champanv guay kaganv 'naaguang the.
Poubauhmei rui chaeng laanclouna bam e;

songs.title: Neihlaa Lungh Kim Mak Kandih khou

lines: 210 Neihlaa Lungh Kim Mak, Kandih khou
1. Neihlaa lungh kim mak kandih khou lungc bam
He aRavguangc, ai guang the Nang pamv khou,
Baihmei kahaw mak ge kandih khouhei.
Ata kanpatlou the Ravguangc Nang rui,
2. Kaganv tingsaengcna Ravguangc ta mpatlou sihnic,
Heicdi kamv ai paapc phungc bam khwan sihnic,
'Zianmei khwan rui ata kaw bam e:
Ai rui Nang hu khou 'peyna maanvlou the.
Ai rui taanc maanvlou kanmei guay tei,
Ningna ai huay e kapna tingmik 'thuih.
Akhang nic bamv nai e heic ramc khoutei.
Ai ningna huay, ai ningna huay!
Zianthaymei Guangh Khrista lwn gaymei tei,
How nii e alung ryanraamei 'thaekc khang.
Zei rui liuna laanclou nyngswpui ramc;
Abumaengc, heicramc gay kiu phaengc bam o,
Kandih ramgai hei tuai kan pwni e.
Guangtangh mak khang alung geicna bam e.
Guangh lunghpui ramc gaymei ai ning 'thuk ge.
212 Neihkhat Pou Jisu rui Mang khou Akhou
1. Neihkhat Pou' Jesu rui mang khou akhou lyanlou e.
Lwmmei nunc lunghpui bamv Ravguangc bampui ramc khou,
Baanch'raa nunc lu suon bam e.
Ai han dat ni mak khe,
Lauziu nac Poubauhmei, Jisu liuloupui ramc e.
2. Kandih khou 'tam kanmei rup-ryan, pu-chaih guay nic,
Ravguangc ta thuanhpui lu suanna neihlaa bam e,
3. Mbaanv ringting luaina tingkauh nzwantat pwkhou,
Laukhwan riw kumc pwni ryanraamei nai lak khe.
Kaganv tingkwm hei nic tatna bam e;
Aniw panty hei nic tat bam e;
Ai ningngam mak tat kanmei ganv ta.
He ai huay e tingkauh ramc gaymei tei,
Chyng kauhmei lev dui paengc samc 'twan tat ni;
Nzwan di kho Kanaan ramc gay tei.
3. He ai huay e tingkauh ramc tei,
Aniw panty hei nic kim dat lak khe.
Meic ching ching rui lungc nipui ramc tei,
Suc-nuc nau-nianmei nai dat lak khe.
Nang taanv khou lunghlouna bam khang,
Ngin tatmei kumcna tat bammei panty hei.
Meic ching ching panty 'maan kan the.
Phu tow mak ge heic kandic khou,
Chariakh thayna lungc bam di kho,
3. Heic kandic khou chabwan guay hei,
Khuamguang ngam khang dinc tat di kho
Rih tei adow khang tat di kho.
Tatpat di kho 'zianmei rup-ryan guay le,
Lungning tanhmei nunc sw la ri tho.
Kandih khou guangh kandic guay hei 'maan ngam pwni,
Saa ngammakmei pingmei guang pwni hei khoutei.
Ning makmei kaganv khou guang pwni.
Kaipouc rui thauna kaikhamv mbang kan pwkhou,
Kapna huay bam pwni mpaeng zinghmei khoutei.
2. Ringhmei Ravguangc lat hei chulou lana,
Kandih khou ryanraa ryanriumei tei guang pwkhou;
Mikdui rouna ntamvmei lwn tei how pwni.
3. Hei kandic khou lungc bammei kaguay khou,
Chu lana how lana thay lana lwm makmei,
Tingkauh kaidai khoutei kaniw khang bamv maek ge.
4. Kandih khou Gaychamv dinc bammei guay hei,
Tingkauh thangc lungh khang tat kan pwkhou,
'Taw lwm makmei guay rui gulou khang phu pwkhou,
Zaylouna dincloumei maek pwni heic khoutei.
Nang thaucmai khou tei thauh chamdaanv tho
Thauh naimei guay daanc thau 'chamc tho.
Thauh maekmei guay daanc nuh mak khe.
Thauh naimei guay daanc thau kan the.
Kauh liangmei khou kazanc hym daic kan diuc!
Liu khang tat dat kan the.
2. Ravguangc tuang tingmik hei luai guang the,
Nang pumc lev nang kaikhunc kapwmna,
3. Gaychamv dinhmei ganv tei luai guang the;
Sina taanhmei guay taanc bam kan diuc,
Ravguangc Lat ta piuna lungc o,
Ravguangc Lat tei suai zat mak ge.
Dinc tat ro kabamv thuih khou.
Tiipat ro nang syan nang lanv guay,
Tiipat ro nang chwn nang lung,
Nang lungning Jisu khang tii o,
Paapc chaeng khou ngalanc dat ri tho,
'Dih chwn phungcna lungc dat ri tho,
Jisu khou pumtan ney lana kaamcthau la tho,
Cross tei phungcna dinc ruantat tho,
2. Nang ta Rav' rui damc chuylou the,
Nang ramthai khou ngangv dat ri tho,
Cross tei zaucna hu thangc gut tho,
Kawmei khwan tei nking la tho,
Kaganv nai khou dinc ruantat tho,
Nthuanh khang daeklou dat ri tho.
4. Kandih taanv khang 'tin dat ri tho,
Adow tho, rih ngam pwni the.
Dinclou mak ge lat gaymei guay,
Kaganv thuih Pou ta ai thuanc ni,
Kaamcthau ni the zingc nic gaanc nic,
Lwm khang maek ge nang bangc ai mu,
Ryanraa khou nic neihlaa khou nic,
Zaylou na ro nang bangc ata.
Nang Chamdaanv bam the cho tingkauh tat khangtei?
Aniw ta keylaa nimei ganv tei thay mak ge.
'Chu nzaenghmei khwan rui kaw bam e.
2. Bible khou heicpui lat hei nic hylou the
Azaeng khourui nangniw ta zauczih pwni.
Tingsaeng zaengna lwmloumei guay rui ringc pwni.
3. Aniw ta tarou ruina nzwan tat bam e,
Nang chamdaanv bam the cho tingkauh tat khangtei?
Latzan sw nimei tingmik tei meic thay mak ge.
4. Ntaw nic nang kumh bam dat ni hena cho?
Karamc kailuangc kathanc khoutei gut khangrui,
Kaniw pangc khoutei nang tatpat la tho.
Lat rui nic saatangc ngammak ge.
Guanglou dat ro meic kathuihna khou.
Tingsaeng gaymei chaeng tei maan dat mak khang,
Ryanraa zinghmei ramc tigaanclou diuc khang,
Mai chuanghmei kumc Bumaengh Than' guang o.
2. Theihmei nganvna khaengvna theic kanmei guay,
Nduanghgut ro tingsaeng gaymei ramc khou,
3. Bumaengh Thanmei nzianmei guang dat ro,
Ringc nii the paapc khou maanmei guay rui,
Tingsaeng' ringc nimei chaeng tei thay makna,
4. 'Muc saeng lak khe thing ruc khou khaengvloumei,

songs.title: Pou' Jisu rui Kaw e Akhou Guang o twna

lines: 224 Pou' Jisu rui Kaw e Akhou Guang o
1. Pou' Jisu rui kaw e akhou guang o twna,
Apanty nai saanv kataanv hei taanc bam ni.
Ravguangc zauzian ta thuanc bam ni.
2. Gu'meipu khou guang tho nang paap guay khiu 'than khang,
Kakhou guangmei guay meic thanh the.
3. Lwmmei guay khang katuang ch'rynmei pumtan tilou,
Gaychamv khang rui tat pat di kho.

songs.title: Pouh Jisu rui 'Niw khou Heickumna Dincloue

lines: 1. Pou' Jisu rui 'niw khou heickumna dinclou e.
Nangniw guay hei kandih khang ntey e.
Kabamv kathuih khou bammei zaat guay khou,
Ntey kumcna ringhmei chamv dinctat ro.
2. Pou' Jisu rui 'niw khou heickumna dinclou e
Nangniw guay hei mbaanv khang gaanhmei e.
Paapc tuang zinghmei khou lungc bammei guay khou,
Gaanh' riw phungcna meicnunc khou tigaanc o.
3. Pou' Jisu rui 'niw khou heickumna dinclou e
Meic kathuih khou kataanv taanv thei layna,
Aswan nzanhlou khang Ai guang dat pwni.
Taanc chuyloumei guay tei sangaymei e.
1. Pou Ravguangc bamv Jerusalem Thanh khou,
Kahymdaihmei zanc hei saana bam khwan sihnic,
Kaidai gaymei khoutei zaatc kaguayna rui,
Aniw rui mwnpwang tuai kanmei, puangc dat nimei,
3. Zaat guay khourui kasing chak ngam lakmei,
Tingmik 'thuih Lauziunac guangh bamvpaeng hu khou,
Kaidai khou gutmei bumaengc tei chak ngam lak ge.
4. Ringhmei latrik khou zanh hyloumei nunc,
Kaniw khang Gu'meipu rui bamv chamdaanvlou,
Ai rui bampui bamv heic khoutei e.
Heicpui bamv khoutei ai tat pwni.
Bw-neih rui gaanhmei kariw nai lak khe,
Paapc taanhmei guay, paapc phunghmei guay rui,
Gut ngam lak ge, ryanraamei sw pwni,
Akumhpui ganv khou guangtangc ni cho?
Ai rui khoutei tangh khang tat pwni e.
Ai rui bampui bamv heic khoutei e.
1. Pou' zianmei khourui ai ruan 'maan khwan e;
Zingbangc nic kalaanv nic Pou' rui 'khwan;
Kamei rui 'zianmei ta patlou mak ge.
Pou' zianmei lam khou lungh khou makumh ki,
Ai nic 'zianmei lam khou rac ruan tat ni;
2. 'Zianmei Pou' Jisu rui cross ruc khou tei,
Nang khang rui dui tarina kauc bam.
Nang thu 'zianmei Pou' khang dui tii lak cho?
Tabui swna nang tii zihna cho?
3. Nang panty gaymei hei Poubauhmei rui,
'Maan kanmei lauziu ta gaengc guang khang,
Nang thu ngalanc guang makna ruantat bam;
T'ui swna nang guang zihna bam cho?
4. Pou' rui saa e lautay diuc khang guang tho,
Katuang lau guay minc raam ngam ni the.
Kamei rui latryan rianhlou e nang khou,
5. Guang o, 'zianmei nang 'bui thangc maeng 'maan ni?
Zingbangc nic, kalaanv nic nang ta khwan bam,
Zianna kaw e ntaw guang la tho.
1. Poubauhmei guang dat nimei ganv kiu anaa guang pwthe;
Zauc lo, kaganv hei anaa ranv guang pwthe.
Oh, Halleluijah! Jisu rui guanghtu the.
Thau tho, thau tho abumaengc le!
Jisu Khrista rui guanghtu nimei ganv guang the;
Oh, Halleluijah! Jisu rui guanghtu the.
2. Poubauhmei guang dat nimei ganv kiu anaa guang pw the;
Muangh khou dungcna kahym daicna key pwni.
Kauh liangmei khou kahym daic diuc!
Oh, Halleluijah! Jisu rui guanghtu the.
3. Poubauhmei guang dat nimei ganv kiu anaa guang pwthe;
Zauc lo, Zion chyng ruc khou key dat pwni;
Oh, Halleluijah! Jisu rui guanghtu the.

songs.title: Poubauhmei Jisu Guang Zaic Pwni the

lines: 1. Poubauhmei Jisu guang zaic pwni the,
Baanch'ra ching ching lev muangh ruc khou.
Tingsaengc lak khe heic kandic hei.
2. Kakhou lwmlou makmei kaguay tei mu,
3. He Tingkauh Jirusalem thanh gay tei,
Pou' ta thuanc bam ni the
4. He adih gay ni cho tingkauh ramc tei:
'Maan kanmei guay ta gulou dat khang.
Meic nunc tuang paap zaeng khangruina,
Theiclou kan the Meic Nac Mpouh tei.
Zinghmei paap guay ta khiu 'thanlou the.
Kahawmei guay guang katumc la tho.
3. Paapc phunghmei guay ta gulou khang,
T'ui swna Guangh daic liangmei tei,
Khouringh kuak lev thing kros ruc khoutei,
Adih ryanraana khaengv kan tu cho!
4. Zaatc kapwmna nic guang zauc lo;
Mi kandic hei amaan ngam sihnic,
Alat kaeng thu khatna sihnic amaan dat lak khe.
He Jisu Nang guang dat nimei ta,
Nthanmei nunc ta laathau nungc kiu,
Kazauh lak ge paapc phunghmei nunc.
2. Ravguangc guangcdic khou gut nuh khang,
Kaganv tei baanch'raa nunc nic thay mak.
Meic Nac Mpouh guang nimei kaihouhmei kumc guang 'ni.
3. Meic Nac Mpouh guang nimei khang,
Khat ta laana khat ta lou duc 'ni,
Lwmmakmei guay ta ganclou pwni hei ganv khoutei.
Tingkauh kandic how ngam mak ge saa e
Nang rui apaap guay kuaklou o,
Nang hamhna akhang chaeng baihmei maek ge.
Kuaklou na ro, Ravguangc kuaklou na ro.
Tat dat rethei nang theic pwni saa e.
Nang guangcdic guang tangh mak saanv,
Nang baanzat rui ata zaylou na ro.
Kamei guang nimei ganv tangc the,
Kahym daicna keymei ta how ni.
Neihlaamei kim dat zat lak khe.

songs.title: Poubauhmei rui Kaw e, Paapc Phunghmei ta

lines: 1. Poubauhmei rui kaw e paapc phunghmei ta;
Nang paap tei zei kumcna haengc bam sinic,
Guang la tho nang adih nyan bam ni cho?
Kawna bam the nang ta zianpui zaeng rui;
Gunh kumcna ti-mphwanlou ni tw e.
Guangmei guay mu neihlaana bam ni,
Halleluijah thuancna bam ni Jisu ta.
2. Kalat piumei nunc dwan gaymei sw ni.
Adih gay ni guloumei sw e thei;
Tingkauh ramc khou Kahym daihmei sw ni.
Ngammeipu Jisu khou guanglou la tho.
3. Kaikhamv laanc bam khouhei guanglou la tho;
Kaganv ri pwni the katumc la tho.
Siimei taanv guay ta mpatlou la tho,
Nyan la ri tho kaganv ri pwni the.
4. Nthuanh khang daeklou bam dat la ri tho;
Aseic tingmik Jisu ta laalou tho.
Theihmei paapc chaeng khourui ngalanc guang tho;
San-gaymei sw la tho 'zianmei nunc le!

songs.title: Poubauhmei Tingkauh Ramc khou Zaylou o

lines: 1. Poubauhmei, tingkauh ramc khou zaylou o;
Meic ching ching rui nzwan tat,
2. Apu rui guang tho twna kawpui nungc,
Guang khang apu rui kaw bam;
1. Pumh gayna lunghmei panty hei 'maan zaic pwni the;
Chanaa thiu ningzauc lo kaganv maek khe.
Nang lung laic tho tingkauh kandic 'naa the.
Kaganv sii the, kaganv dui the;
Nang lung laic tho, tingkauh guangcdic 'naa the.
2. He ringhmei chamv chu makmei nunc zauc lo, chanaa thiu,
Tingsaeng lungc nimei guangcdic kiu zaucna,
3. Neihlaa zaenggaymei ganv duidutnamei lungc khouhei,
Kaganv maek khe Poubauhmei taanv taanh khang;
Neihlaana Poubauhmei taanv taanc di kho.
Kakhou tiilouna lwmlou nungc tei rui.
Ai suan ni thuanhpui lu tei,
Ai thay tangc ngam mak ge Ravguangc.
Ai thay tangc ngam mak ge, (2)
Ch'rynmei Kazauzian hej saa ngam mak ge.
Kaganv nai bam khou lwm laa tho.
Kakhou lwmloumei panty sw la tho.
Champanv nang ringhbamv lam thay thah?
Zinghmei bamv thangctei nzwan kan the.
Tingsaeng ryanraa ramc nzwan kan the.
2. Lwmmei nunc Pou' lev tat 'chamc ni.
Chanaa nangniw zauc ngam ni cho?
Ryanraa bammei ta zauc ngammak ge.
3. Rapchar ganv khou guangh bamv 'zwan ni;
Nang rui tabui bamv 'zwan ni cho?
Zauc ngamlak ge maikwam tatmei ta.
1. Ravguangc guang makpui hu khou chamdaanv tho,
Khristian gaymei guay nic ramhthayna lungc o.
Baibal thaymei guay rui nic han ngam pwni,
Chuangc bammei mai kimkey kan pwkhou kiu.
Nthei han ngam kan ni de mi ganv khou kiu,
Kapna huay sihnic guang dat lak khe.
Kaipouc ta thay makpui ganv guang pwni;
Khou kiu Kamei guang pwni the.
2. Tingkauh thangc bammei baanch'raa guay tei rui,
Lwmloumei guay ta laa khang guang pwni the.
Ntaw nangniw rui lwmlou mak gethei mu,
3. Ringhmei latchamv dinc ruantat bam shnic,
Kalung khou Bumaengh lungclou makmei guay thu,
Adih sansi pwni cho heicpui nungc kiu.
Tingsaeng zaeng amaanmei kiu sw pwni.
4. 'Taw chuangc bammei mai bwang hei tingsaeng zaeng,
Ravguangc guang makpui saanv chuangc bam khang sw kho.
Heicpui Bumaengh mai hei kimkęy kan ethei,
Baanhzaap bam sihnic ngalanc dat lak khe.

songs.title: Ravguangc Nac Jisu Kandih khou Puanh' nungc

lines: 1. Ravguangc nac Jisu kandih khou puanh nungc
Tingkauh mei nunc lev kandihmei guay,
Neihlaa 'chamcna Ravguangc hym ta thuanc e -
Kauh liangmei khou kahym daic kan diu.
Dih khou chwn gay' chu-zaenghmei phungcguang,
Dihmei guay rui guang ta thuan e.
2. Tingkauh Ravguangc nac Jisu hei puanc the,
Tingkauh baanch'raa guay thuanhpui lu suan e-
Tingkauh thangc Ravguangc him dai diu.
Guloumeipu Jisu zanc ta thuanc e,
Tingsaeng zaengna kahym daic kan diu.
1. Ravguangc ramzian daihmei katin phaengc tangc ngammak,
Karamzian nthukmei kasyng phaengc tangc ngammak;
Karamzian kauhmei hei mik rui phaengc tangc ngammak;
Thuanc di kho damcloumei Ravguangc ta.
2. Ringc bammei panty hei Poubauhmei zauzian e;
Thuancku di kho Katuang suaihiam laatowmei tei,
Nang khou naimei guay tei Ravguangc khang tiipat ro:
3. Nang tiipatloumei tei nang laatow dat pwni.
Nang rui lwm bam sihnic taanv kazauh mak gethei,
Ravguangc hu khou nang ramneilaa nthuih ngammak;
Pou' ta thuanc o kasuaihiam tiilou the
Panty gaymei tiiloumei hei kasuaihiam e
Ravguangc ramzian kandih khouhei padik khwan e
Ravguangc zauzian tiiloumei hei thuancku di kho.
Ravguangc rui swan tii pwni the.

songs.title: Ravguangc rui Aniw ta Nzianna Kawbam

lines: 1. Ravguangc rui aniw ta nzianna kaw bam;
Aniw Kataanv taancna bam diu khang.
Chulou o, Nang nzianmei guay rui,
Nkhavlou diu khang ningna kalum e.
He Ravguangc Nang ngamv tei ch'ryn e;
Kandihmei guay rui Nang ta kaw bam;
Chulou o, Nang nzianmei guay rui,
Tingsaengc tingsaengcna Nang ta kalum e.
2. Pinglou ri o nzianmei chabwan guay thiu le !
Zinghpui kandic khou 'niw bam saanv khou,
Nkhavlou diuc khang ningna kalum e.
3. Nang nzianmei aniu chabwan kin guay ta,
Nkhavlou diu khang ningna khwan bam.
Tat kanmei ganv tei ngalanc dat lak khe.
1. Ravguangc rui ata nzianpui zaeng rui,
'Zianpui zaeng rui e twmei ai thay,
Tingsaeng zaeng ai thuanc bam ni Ravguangc ta
Pou' rui 'zian e twmei ai thay e;
Ntaw ai lwm the Bumaengh lat ta;
Tingsaeng zaeng ai thuanc bam ni Ravguangc ta.
2. Kazei paan rui ai ringhbamv laatow the,
Ata kanlou the Kazei paan rui,
Tingsaeng zaeng ai thuanc bam ni Ravguangc ta.
3. Lwmmei paan rui Kazauzian laatow the,
Khrista key pwkhou ai neihlaa ni.
Ata key laa pwnimei ai thay;
Ai neihlaana Kamei lev tat 'chamc ni.
1. Ravguangc rui mbaanv maansei ta heicdikamv nzianna,
Thow pwnic Kakhou lwmloumei guay rui maan dat makna.
2. Heicdi daihmei ringhbamv tihei ntaamv bammei guay,
Ravguangc tuang lungpuam bam khou keylou pwni.
Jesu khou lwmloumei guay tingsaeng zaeng ringhmei laa ni
3. Ravguangc khou lwmmei guay khang bamv
Kakhou lwmloumei guay lev tingsaeng lungc 'cham pwni.
Tingsaeng zaeng neihlaa bam ni the.

songs.title: Ravguangc rui Damcloumei Maansei guay ta

lines: 1. Ravguangc rui, damcloumei maansei guay ta, nzian khourui,
Kanac Mpouh akhatnamei ta tiilou the.
Kata lwmloumei guay rui ringc pwni,
2. Mpwan liu rihri e, tingkauhramc tei, zianmei guayle,
Gunh kumcna mphwanmei bamv khoutei ai bam ni.
Neihkhat khoutei ai rihngam lu suan ni,
3. Salem namvdai ringhmei thingbang lim khou,
Tingkauh baanch'ra guay lev thuancku kariu lana,
Ravguangc ta thuanckupui lu tei suanna,

songs.title: Ravguangc rui Damcloumei Puat Guay hei

lines: 1. Ravguangc rui damcloumei puat guay hei!
Zauc lo, ch'ryn e Kabaansiam guay.
2. Chyng lev nzaengc, duipui duithuak guay,
Kauh thangc bw lev gaanchuangc guay nic,
How tangh makmei Zion ramc gay',
1. Ravguangc rui dinhmei ganv tei guang tangc pwthe:
Kabamv thuih khou pat bam the;
Kakwm kaganv nic kalaic ngam the.
Zinghmei tei guang zaic pwni the,
Ravguangc khou nang lwmlou la tho.
2. Heic kandih hei mu Nouha kaanc khou kumc the:
Kandih ramgai ta phumei guay rui,
3. Nzianmei tat rey kanmei rupryan guay rui,
4. Aniw panty hei mu tỉngzyn ganv kumc the;
Tat kanmei ganv tei guang dat lak khe,
Nang rui kapna huay bam sihnic,
Kaganv tei ngalanc dat lak khe.
Kalat piuna Kata lwmmei guay rui,
Theihmei nganv lwmloumei rui ringhmei pyrun,
Kataanv taanhmei khang Kahym daihmei pyrun,
Kamv dat lakmei pyrun tii ni.
2. Jisu rui latzan sw tang pwkhou kiu,
Pyrun laatow makmei kaguay tei mu,
3. Ravguangc rui tiimei pyrun run lana,
Thow pw nic lwmmei rui 'maan dat makna,
Tingsaeng zaeng ringcsuangmei tei laa pwni.
Heic kandic rui che sw sihnic,
Thingchiang guay rui hypei sw sihnic,
Hy ngam mak ge ch'rynmei Ravguangc ramzian.
2. Tingkauh thangc rui Ravguangc Nac 'Pouh Khrista,
Kandihmei paap guay ta laaduaklou khang,
Syang bangc khou bammei aniw kapwm ta,
Gulou the ch'rynmei Ravguangc zauzian rui.
Ngangcthauna thuanc o, Ravguangc zauzian tei.

songs.title: Ravguangc rui Meic Khatna ta Sihnic

lines: 252 Ravguangc rui Meic Khatna ta Sihnic
1. Ravguangc rui meic khat na ta sihnic swmaan nii mak ge;
Tihkic lungh laicna kakhou guangmei ta laanii e.
Ravguangc Bumaengc ruina heic kumna dinclou
Nang kandic 'maan nipui ganv katumcna gang pwthe.
Lwmlou la tho, lungh laic la tho,
2. Heic kandic hei paapc ruina guanghtuna lunghpui bamv e.
Siimei paapc taanv taanh khangtei raana phuna lungc bam.
Tu lana zangv lana mbaa bammei kaguay,
Ning makmei ganv khou nang kandic hei 'maan pwni the.
3. Nang kandic hei Sodom lev Gomora lev nchamce:
Saa ngammakmei ryanraa pingmei ganv tei guang pwni.
'Khamhpui ganv guang pwthe paapc rui guanghtupui ganv.
Chakin charin maek pwni 'khamhpui ganv guang pwkhou.
4. 'Zianmei nunc le, kaganv hei chak lana lungh laic la tho;
Zauc 'zianloupui ganv guay tei tat twan kan pwni the:
Nouha rui lunghpui ganv khou pat kanmei kumcna,
Kapna huayna bam sihnic gulou dat pwlak khe.
Kakwan khatna kumhmei mwnpwang guayna ta,
2. Mbaanv khou aniw guay panty hei,
Kabamv baih baih thangc samctatna bam sihnic

songs.title: Ravguangc rui Paapc Phunghmei guay ta

lines: 1. Ravguangc rui paapc phunghmei guay ta,
Heic kandic mu ryanraa kappui ramc e.
Chwnsi mikdui luanghmei rui padik ge.
Hanguang dat ro, Guloumeipu pamv khou;
'Zianmei khwan rui nang ta kawna bam khou.
Zauzian khwan rui kawna bam khou guang tho,
Nthuanh thu nang Kakhwan chu mak nuh e.
Meic aching ching ta gulou khang.
'Zianmei nunc le, aseic guang zihna cho?
Theihmei lay tanghmak khou ngalanc guang o.
Ryanraamei maikwam khou kapna bam e.

songs.title: Ravguangc rui Nineveh Namvdai ta Nzian e

lines: 1. Ravguangc rui Nineveh namvdai ta nzian e;
Simei taanv khourui lungh laic diu khang,
Chamv dinh khang Jonah ta ndiu the.
Nineveh namvdai thangc tei kauc lana dinc tat tho."
Jonah tei rui Nineveh namdai thangctei tat kan the.
Jonah rui heic namvdai chaengluang khoutei,
Lungh laic tho, lungh laic tho twna dinc ruanlou the.
Nineveh namvdai tei lungh laic kan the,
'Maan nimei khourui Ravguangc rui gulou dat kan the.
2. Ravguangc rui Amitai nac mpouh Jonah ta,
Chamv dinh khang kata ndiulou the.
Jonah rui Ravguangc lat piu makna,
3. Jonah rui Ravguangc lat piu makna leytat the,
Rungh khou tuangc tatna dui khou keylou.
Khavkui rui "luakcna neih thumh bam the;
Nang khou naimei guay zuanc lana,
Tingkauh thangc nang lanv tei rylou o.
Laatowmei suangc tiipatmei rui dwangay e.
Tingkauh thangc khang tiipatna taancthau di kho.
2. Ringhpouc rui nangniw khou kumna saa
Ringhpouc tuang syang kakhou keylou ni.
3. Gaymei taanv khou lakmei swbam ri tho,
Maanmei bumaengc guay khang taancthau tho.

songs.title: Ravguangc ta Thuanc o Meic guay le

lines: 257 Ravguangc ta Thuanc o Meic Guayle!
1. Ravguangc ta thuanc o meic guayle !
Thut phuilou khang nkhwan bam the.
3. Mik rui how makmei tingkauh thangc,
Thuanhmei lu suan taek dat lak khe.
Aniw nic lay suan tat di kho.
4. Tingkauh ramc thangc lwmmei guay rui,
Lungh khang tat ngam kanpui tangv kiu,
5. Ntavw kin khou lungc bammei nunc.

songs.title: Ravguangc Taanv Taanh khang Maansei Rau e

lines: 1. Ravguangc taanv taanh khang maansei rau e,
Ravguangc taanv taanc nimei maekna cho?
Kasing geihmei bumaengc 'maan ngam pwni the.
He Khrista khangrui chabwan nunc guay thiu,
Phuc ngam makmei 'maan nimei guay ta,
Ravguangc hu khou tabui daw ni;
Kaniw zei manv tei aniw khou ney pwni.
2. Ravguangc taanv taanh khang maansei rau e,
Taanclou diu khang maansei ta phu e;
Aniw Racguangc hei lungcsimei dina cho?
3. Ravguangc taanv taanh khang maansei rau e;
Guangh Jisu rui 'niw ta kaw bam e;
Ganclou ducna Ravguangc khang taanv taanc di kho.
4. Ravguangc taanv taanclou diu khang huay e:
'Niw lanv guay tabui khang dina cho?
Guanghdic khang rui tiipat di kho,
Aniw khou gaymei naimei guay tiipat kho.
1. Ravguangc tuang siamruai sw nimei thow cho?
Khav nym bam khou Pitar ta kaw khwan e;
Taanv 'tynmei ganv khou kaniw ta kaw e:
Dinc tatloumei guay tei sangaymei e.
Neihmik key mak khou taanv taanc la tho;
Kandih laudai minc nzinh ngam the;
Ravguangc nang taanv zauh khang guangpui nungc kiu,
Baanh raeng bam pwramc e taanv taanc la tho.
2. Aseic nang taanvphy tei 'phang mak nuh e;
Nthei thangc khang ningna kataanv taanc o.
Jisu nang ta nzianmei latchamv hei,
Nang taanv dwan hei dinc ruantat khang di the.
3. Ravguangc, ai rui Nang taanv taanc nimei hei,
Kat patlou the Nang phaypav bangc khoutei.
Nang phaydyng tei ding 'tip la tho;
Guang pwni the, pat pwni the.
Nang laupuk khou, nang pikwan khou;
Nang ki, nang ruai, nang kaikhunc khou;
Chu pwni the, how pwni the:
3. Khouringh guay khou, phwnling guay khou;
Guang pwni the, pat pwni the.
4. Nouha kin khou pat kanmei tei,
'Dih nam ruc khou kalung p'rik guay,
Guang pwni the, pat pwni the.
Ntaw thu ai rui thay dat the 'zianloumei tei;
Ai tingsaeng ringh khang Kazei keyna theicloumei.
Kros khou zei rui khiu 'thanlou the.
Meic guayna hei paap padik the.
Sodom lev Gomora khou patmei tei kumcna,
Karaana 'baanvthay khang ningna, Amaan ngam kan the.
Nouha kin khou mei guay tei,
Ravguangc rui dui rui Swmaan the.
Sodom lev Gomnora kaidai mi khoutei nic,
2. Ntaw kin khou nic meic guayna rui,
Poubauhmei rui rianhloumei ganv tei tangc pwkhou,
Ravguangc rui mi kandic hei nic Swmaan ngam pwni.
3. Kumpui zaeng khou rui chanaa nang nic
Aseic rui thauna lungh laic tho.
Nang ta 'zianmeipu rui kadaeng khou guang khang tei,
Kaw bam e, Kanloumeipu rui, Nang ta gulou khang.
Kamei nunc ta lungc dat diu khang ningna,
Pouh-peih guay ta zaypatlou dat the.
Lwmna piumei guay khang na de,
Khou tei guang khang ai lungh laic ni.
2. Lwmlou makmei Israelmei zaat guay ruina,
Pharou baanc khou rui zay patlou sihnic,
3. 'Zianmei nunc ta zay pat nimei zingbangc khoutei,
Lauziu zei rui chaengmun khou teylouna,
Kaniw ta Ravguangc rui kanlou the.
4. Ravguangc rui kandih ta heicdi kamv 'zianlouna,
Kata lwmmei guay ringc dat diu khang.
1. Rimhrimpui ramvlaa khou araana ruantat bam,
Gaanhmei riw how makna paapc lung khou.
Lungh zinghmei khouruina alung tigaanclou o.
Poubauhmei nang baancpav khou ai 'sinlou the
Paapc rui padikmei zinghmei kandic khou,
Bumaengh chaeng thay makna tat maan ngam kan ni the.
Zinghpui ramc khou ai ruantatna ryanraa sihnic,
2. Nchu rihri, rimhrimpui nzaengcdic lim khou,
'Khavlou nimei maek ge paapc lung khou,
Ai zipkey ki zipri thuy mak,
Alung ryanraamei ruina padik bam khou,
Zaylou na ro siimei raana guang pwthe.
3. Kandih ravpui rvapu ta ntamvlou lana
Tat di kho tingkauh Zionramc thangc.
Gaanmei riw how makna ai katham bam khou
Chaeng dinclou na ro a-Poubauhmei le.
Nang mbaanv thaypui ramc khou guangtangh mak saanv.

songs.title: Ringc bam khou Gaypui Taanv Taanc o

lines: 265 Ringc bam khou Gaypui Taan Taanc o
1. Ringc bam khou gaypui taanv taanc o.
Lungh laicguangmei guay rui run pwni.
Siimei paap rui nduangh tat the.
Lwmmei guoy lev ruantat bam ni.
266 Ringhmei Dui tei Guang Zangy latho
1. Ringhmei dui tei guang zangv la tho,
Lakmei guay ringcsuang diu khang tei;
Nang ringh khang Jisu khou guang tho.
2. Ringhmei dui tei guang zangv la tho,
khoutei nang ta nkhwan bam e
Zionramc gay khou lungc diu khang.
3. Ringhmei dui tei guang zangv la tho,
Kaganv rui nang ta 'khwan mak ge.
4. Ringhmei dui tei guang zangv la tho.
Ravguangc lat ta 'taamv la ri o:
Nouha kaanc khou pat kanmei kumc,
Ai Nang khourui ducna tatmei hei,
Aseic tingmik hei Nang pamv khou,
Apanty nai saanv Nang khang sw ni.
2. Kandih ramgai ta ai nzian khourui,
Paapc rui ata nduanghna lungc the.
'Zianmei khwan rui kawmei ai chu e,
Poubauhmei khourui ai maeng duc the;
4. Kaganv gaymei guay tat ri kan the,
Mwnpwang tuaimei kumcna tuai kan the.
Ai rui huaybam sihnic guang dat lak khe,
Tat duc kan the 'zianmei kaganv guay.
268 Ringhpouc Baansyam Kaguay tei Zauc lo
1. Ringhpouc baansyam kaguay tei zauc lo.
Ringhpouc rui aniw khang damc chuylou the.
Ringhpouc ta thuanckuna lungc di kho.
2. Ringhpouc rui damcloumei puatc guay tei,
Maansei aniw rui piu khang damclou the.
Aniw rui mi guay hei taancthau dikho.

songs.title: Ringhpouc Lat Piuna Aniw Lungc dikho

lines: 269 Ringhpouc Lat Piuna Aniw Lungc dikho
1. Ringhpouc lat piuna aniw lungc di kho.
Kalat piuna lungc bammei guay khang
He Ravguangc nang khou huayney e.
Nang suaihiam gaymei tei tiilou o
Aniw rui nang ta thuancna lungc bam khang.
3. He Ringhpouc suaihiam tiikeylou na ro.
Mi suaihiam guay tei tiilou ethei -
Ringhpouc khang tiipatna lungc bam ni.
1. Ryanraa zaengsii' ganv khou ai bam ngam mak;
Neihmik bam key thuy mak ge he Ravguangc.
Mwnpwang tuaimei kumcna puangctuai ni the.
Lungh ryanraana kapmei kandic guay hei,
Duak kan ni the Ravguangc kandic khou mu;
Duak kan ni the 'taw ryanraamei guay hei;
Kandih khourui duakna tangc zaic ni the.
Kaikhunhmei guay nic ntamvpui bamv e.
Eagle ruay kumcna samctat bam sihnic,
3. Tingkauh kaidai khoutei bammei guay mu,
Lungh ryanraana kapmei nai dat lak khe.
Tabui nungc rui ai nic guangtangc ni cho ?
Ravguangc lungpuam kaniw khou guang the.
2. 'Taw nganv lwm makmei nunc ruc khou,
Neih khat ai thay makpui 'dic tangcna,
AKaipouc lev tat 'chamcna alaamh tat pwni.
2. Heic kandic hei tingsaengc lak khe;
Thing rui 'ngeic rui napgou rui swlou ethei,
Nang taanv tei mai rui nchanv pwni.
Mi nungc kiu nang taanv tei mai rui raw ngam pwni.
Lwmmei phaydyng tei ding 'tip la tho.
Kachaekc kumhmei lwmmei tei sw tho.
Khrista ta ariu khang chamdaanv tho.
2. Nangniw hei Ravguang tuang kai kiu e.
Thowkumhmei rui Ravguangc kai swmaan ethei,
Ravguangc rui kata nic swmaan ni.
Lungh laicguang tho nang paap guay tei kuaklou pwni.
3. Alat hei chuna taanhmei guay mu,
Tauhdai h' ruc khou kai swmei kumhmei tuang e.
Tingkauh Guangcdic khoutei ringhmei swan laa pwni.
Puancthanhmei e tw khang biuh mak ge.
2. Bumaengh 'Thanmei hei Ravguangc tuang kaipat re;
Kachaekc kaphut rui liu ngam mak ge.
Ravguangc hym daihmei ta thuanc diu khang,
3. Paapc phungc bam khou Ravguangc lat piu ngammak ge;
Chu nzaenghmei nic laatow mak ge:
4. Thowkumhmei rui Ravguangc zanc khou guang ethei,
Neihlaa zaenggaymei kim dat lak khe:

songs.title: Thow Pwnic Dui lev Bumaengh khou

lines: 275 Thow Pwnic Dui lev Bumaengh khou
1. "Thow pw nic dui lev bumaengh khourui,
Ravguangc Guangcdic khou gut ngam mak ge",
2. Thow pw nic katuang guaihhphu sinna,
Ravguangc Guangcdic mei sw ngammak ge.".
Ravguangc Guangcdic mei sw ngammak ge."
4. "Thow pw nic Athei lay nii ethei,
Katuang cross laathau lana gong o."
1. Thowkumhmei rui Khrista khou bam ethei,
Kamei tei damc thanh datmei kiu di the;
Karaan guay tat twan ngam kan the,
Zauc lo, puatc guayna kathanc ngam the.
Jisu zei rui akhang nsaa tilou.
Alung geihmei guay hei nai dat lak khe;
Zauc lo, akhang puatc guay kathanc ngam the.
2. Akhang Eden kathanc guang dat pwthe;
Jisu khou lwmlou datmei paan khourui,
Theihmei khourui ai ringc dat the;
3. Zinghmei khourui lauthwan gaanc patmei kumc,
Alungning khou kathanc guang dat pwthe.
Theihmei nganvna Nang khang sw ni.
4. 'Zianmei nunc le, Poubauhmei khou guang o;
Kaganv gay khou bumaengh khangrui lungco.
Eden kathanc khou lungc di kho.

songs.title: Tiangkaa Khwan Chu Zaic Pwni the

lines: 277 Tiangkaa Khwan Chu Zaic Pwni the
1. Tiangkaa khwan chu zaic pwni the;
Kaipouc chaengmun khou ding bam the.
Ai zaengsw ni tingkauh ramc khou;
Gay liangpui neic Jisu how ni;
Tingsaeng zaengna thuancna bam ni the.
Neih riw kage maek heic khoutei.
3. Saa ngam thuy lak ge karamgai;
Siimei nai dat mak heic khoutei.
Tingkauh ramc khou theic dat lak khe;
Mikdui luanghmei nai dat lak khe.
Nchyang thaulou dat ro ziprimei ta,
Nang rui hamh 'thei chaeng tat maanv ngam ni the,
Zaylou o, gaanphiu gaanhmei ramc Zion khou;
Ringh' chaeng thay makmei nunc khou.
Nang zei rui thuakloumei hei saa ngammak;
Kandih siimei paapc ric adow sihnic,
Nang zanc thuanhpui lu suan bam ni.
Dinc tat ni Nang sauh pyrun runmei lam;
1. Tingkauh Guangcdic anaa the lunghlaic la tho.
Kaipouc Jisu rui kumna saa e -
2. Ringhpouc rui saa e, guango, athei lay o,
Kaipouc Jisu thei laytat kan the.
3. Kakwm kaganv nai makna Gaychamv dinc o.
Kaipouc Jisu rui kumna saa e -
Taanv taanclou nimei thu meic rau e.
4. Bumaengh khuamguangmei guay tei nyngtyngmei e.
Kaipouc Jisu rui kumna saa e -
Ai rui kakhang swan tilou pwni.
Charuangc daihmei khoutei ai guang bam pwni.
ARavguangc Jisu rui guangna saa e;
Kamei nunc tei muangh ruckhou key pwni the.
Tingsaeng zaeng ringhmei thingbang lim khoutei,
Khwan gaymei guay rui Ravguangc ta thuanc ni.
Nang nic guang zihna cho heic ramc gay khoutei?
Guangtangh khang kaganv hei anaaguang pwthe.
Nang heicramc tangh khang ningna bam tu cho?
Nangniw tat zihna cho heicramc gay khoutei?
Ding ngam ni tuang hamh the mi bamv khoutei;
Lauziu Nac ringhmei latrik khou zanh maekmei.
Kachaekc kaphut kumcna kamv dat zat lak khe:
labui nungc pwsihnic 'tamv dat lak khe;
Neihlaa zaenggayna bam pwni heic khoutei.
Taek dat mak khe hiw bammei khwan tei,
Paapc phunghmei nunc mu chu thưy lak',
Tat nimei tingkauh ramc khou kiu,
2. 'Thei han dat ri tho, lwmloumei guay,
Kandih hei mu zinghpui bamv di the,
3. Tangc zai pwni the, tingkauh ramc kiu,
How zaic ni the, Kaipou Khrista lwn,

songs.title: Tingkauh Kaidai Chaeng tei Zauc lo

lines: 282 Tingkauh Kaidai Chaeng tei Zauc lo
1. Tingkauh kaidai chaeng tei zauc lo;
Tanc-bauhmei kaipouc guay ruan bam e;
Kaniw ramh khat sihnic ping makna,
Tingkauh kai khou neihlaana bam ni.
Kachaekc pyrun runna ruan bam e.
2. Nrah lev khwan gaymei khwan rui,
Gu'meipu ta kaniw thuanc bam e.
Neihlaana rih ngam lu suan bam e.
Aniw guay Nang khou huayney taek mak.
Kandih tuang suc-rih geihpui bamv khou,
Aniw ta Nang pamv khou laalou o.
4. Mi hei neihlaa liangmei kiu e,
Nang hu khou ai guang dingpui nungc kiu,
Neihlaana Nang ta thuancna bam ni.
Lwmmei guay ta laa khang key pwni.
Baanh hiwna neihlaamei kim dat lak he,
Mpwan kumcna khoutei samc bam e.
3. Heic ramc gay khoutei lungc nimei guay,
Muangh khou dungcna Kamei key pwni.
4. Kumna dinc e chamdaanvmei ganv e;
Kaipouc Khrista guang khou tat 'chamc ni.

songs.title: Tingkauh Kandic hou ai Lungphui Bamv

lines: 284 Tingkauh Kandic khou Ai Lunghpui Bamv
1. Tingkauh kandic khou ai lunghpui bamv
Chamdaanv khang Poubauhmei tat kan the.
Bumaengh Nthanmei lev lu suanna bam ni.
Mi ramc thangc tei neihkhat tat pwni.
Apanty hei luaipui nungc kiu mu,
Tingkauh kandic akai thangc ai tat ni the.
Zauczihmei rui ngammei nai dat lak khe.
4. Tingkauh Kaidai ai tanghpui nungc kiu,
Bw lev neih rui gaanhmei nai lak khe,
Khatsihnic maek khe tingkauh ramc khoutei.
Zauc lo, maansei aching ching rui,
Kaipouc rui 'thanmei kaguay ta nduangh lana,
Aseic hei kaw e, kaw e:
Adihkamv gay cho ringhbamv nsaa tiiloumei.
2. 'Niw ni gut di kho ringhmei chaeng khou;
Ringhmei kai biak thangc nzwanna tat gut di kho;
Guang tangh khang anaa guang the.
3. Kaipouc guanghdic taanv taanh khang kaw e;
Kaganv hei 'naa the, ndiumei khou tat di kho;
1. Tingkauh ramgai maansei rui saa ngammak ge.
Phwamling mei nzianmei nunc guay le,
Kapu rui kanac guay ta nkhwanna bam the;
Katumcna lungh laicna guang la tho.
Aniw guay phwamling tingkauh thangc nai e.
Lungh geic dat ri tho 'zianmei guay le;
Meic guayna khang bamv chamdaanv luailou the.
Khou tei meic guayna Hallelujah kauc ni.
2. Kandih ta ntamv nipui ganv guang pwthe;
Kaganv hei maek khe nyan la ri tho.
Nazareth Jisu rui zay kariulou pwni.
3. Khrista ruina saa e "Lungning nchamc o."
Tingkauh thangc kamei lev lungc nchamc pwni the.
Lwmloumei guay kanac ling sw ni.
Nangniw lung lev nang pumc kaguay tei,
Lwmlou la tho Ravguangc rui saa e.
1. Tingkauh ramc gay Saruan mwn puanghpui ramc,
Gaanc guang dat ro he Pou' Jisu alung khouhei:
Chaeng maanvmei lauziu nac kumc ai ruantat bam khou,
Ai ryanraa the Kaipouc Jisu, 'khavlou na ro.
He adi gay kan tu cho Guloumeipu!
Ryanraa kapmei nai dat lak khe
2. Lauziu Nac rui gaancna bampui ramc khou,
Lwmmei guay tingsaengcna mbaanvthay pwni the;
Ravguangc chuangphey haina Hosanna kauc di kho.
3. Paapc tuang duidai tei guang zaic pwni the;
Lwmlou makmei guay mbaanv khou bam pwni the;
Kandih' lungcgaymeipu kumc amaan pwni the.
Theihmei dui paengc ramc gay khoutei kaanpatlou o.
Khwan gaymei khwan rui thangctei guang khang kaw bam,
'Zianmei rupryan guay nic khoutei khwan bam.
Oh adih gay cho tingkauh ramc tei!
2. Tingkauh raengmun tei mu mbangh dat zat lak ge.
Khoutei gutmei guay tingsaeng neihlaa bam ni.
Pou' ta thuanhpui khwan rui kagaengv bam e.
3. Tingkauh Seraphim guay lu thanh gaymei su.
Kaipouc Jisu ta thuancna neihlaa bam e.
Kaniw neihlaamei tei kimkey dat mak khe.
4. Tingkauh kandic khoutei guloumei alauc guay,
Ringhmei thingbang lim khou Ravguangc hym thuanc e.
Zianmei pui-pu guay ta khwanna bam e.

songs.title: Tingkauh Thangc khang Kataanv Taanc o

lines: Nang panty guay, nang syan lanv guay.
Nang tuang phwnling guay rui nic,
1. Tingkauh thangc khudamc guay rui nchinna bam the;
Jonah khou pat kanmei tei ningzauc o;
Ai nic paapc phunghmei e twna lungh laic guang o;
Lungh laic guangmei kamv ta laalou pwni.
Latzan kaipouc Jisu chaengmun khou ding bam the;
Nouha kaanc khoutei pat kan the 'zianmei nunc.
Lwmlou lana nang mik tei hu thangc zaucpat ro;
2. Reynungc lwmlou makmei Sodom kinmei kumcna,
Bumaengh ta sinnuimei guay lungh laic tho;
Heic tei kumcna nangniw khou nic guang pwni the,
Neih khatna khourui amaan ngam pwni.
3. Tingkauh Jirusalem khou chaengmun ruh kanei;
Baanch'raa ruhna kanei tei ding bam the.
Ringcsuangmei Latrik khou zanh hylou makmei guay,
Maikwam chaeng khoutei kaniw gut pwni.
4. Tiangkaa khwan rui kauc pwni the nzianmei nunc;
Kalaan ny, zingbangc pwny thay mak ge.
Nangniw khangrui dinhmei lu tei suanna bam o;
Tingkauh thangc rui kaganv maek khe dinc e.

songs.title: Tingkwm Aching Aching Tat kan the

lines: 1. Tingkwm aching aching tat kan the dui luangh kumc;
Meickin meickin nic tuai kan the.
Gaymei kaganv guay ri kan the mang kumcna,
Guang nimei zuk thanh ta agwn e.
Millennium guangdic Pou' Khrista tuang guangcdic,
Khoutei pingmei suc-rih nai dat lak khe.
2. Tingkwm aching aching luailou the aseic hei,
Tingkwm thanh, zuk thanh guang pwthe.
Pou' Khrista tuang Jubilee guang pwni the;
Ch'rynmei ngaidai sw pwni hei khoutei.
3. Tingkauh Jubilee tuang kaengcdai hiw pwni the;
Khoutei 'tamv bammei nunc ta sowriu dat ni;
Ch'rynmei ngaidai sw pwni heic khoutei.
1. Tingkwm kaganv hei luai guang the heic kandic hei;
Baibal khou saaloumei tei guang tangc the.
He Baibal lat piu makmei guay,
Latzan hu khou 'maanmei tei laa pwni.
He lwmlou la tho kandihmei guay;
Kaipouc rui chaengmun khou dingna khwan bam the.
Niamh gaymei khwan rui kawna kabai bam;
Ntaw gut la tho 'zianna kaw e.
2. Kaipouc rui chaengmun khou dingna nkhwan bam the;
Chamdaanv la tho Kaipouc guang pwni the.
Latzan hu khou 'maanmei tei laa pwni.
3. Paapcmei guay ta nzianloumei hei tingsaengc the;
Chamdaanv la tho, Kaipouc guang pwni the.
'Maan dat makmei maikwam khou gut pwni.
Kazanc khourui karik guay tei theic kan diu:
2. Ngammei baanc zaythau khou siimei ravsic
Karei pwni ringhmei baanc kahi pwkhou.
Gay makmei ravsic guay ta nthauganc e;
Tingkwm kaganv nai dat lak khe.
Ringhmei dui tei zangv pwni the,
Duipaengc ramc gay khou 'khwan bam e.
Heicramc gay tei saa ngam mak ge;
Khoutei neihlaa tuai dat lak khe.
Paapc zaeng cross khou theicloumeipu ta,
Kandihmei guay rui thuanc kan diuc!
Kamei nunc guay ta laa dat diuc khangrui,
Mai rui raw ngam kan pwni.

songs.title: Zauc lo, Kandih Khouhei Alun Dai

lines: 296 Zauc lo, Kandih Khouhei Alun Dai
1. Zauc lo, kandih khou hei alun dai guang pwthe;
Heic tei tu-zangv khang maekpui tuang alun hamh e.
Ravguangc chamv chu nii sihnic chutow lakmei ganv,
Tingmik tei guang tangc pwni the.
Duipui khat thangcrui duipui khat thangc nganv,
Neihpat biak thangcrui neihkey thangc nganvna,
Ravguangc chamv chu nina phu bam sihnic,
Phutow dat zat ni tuang hamh the.
2. Khristian geihmei guay nic chaeng tat maanv ngam pwni;
Ravguangc Lat 'thukmei tei chutow dat pwlak khe.
Tihkic lwmlou tina thuakpatloumei guay ta,
3. Zauc lo, aseic hei guloumei tingmik kiu the:
Duidaihmei kumcna Ravguangc Lat hei dinc bam the.
Nang aseic hei Jisu ta laalou mak gethei,
Nthuanh thu phutow dat lak khe.

songs.title: Zauc lo, Ravguangc Baansyam guay rui

lines: 1. Zauc lo Ravguangc baansyam guay rui gaanc bam e
Damhmeipu rui khwan bam, 'zian lunghsina nang ta
Rigun e how niimei rui damcthanhmei kandic ta
He kandih maansei guay rakpat tho
Guang la tho nang gaanhmei riw khoutei
Kandi rui ni cham dao pat re.
2. Zauc lo Ravguangc baansyam guay rui gaanc bame
Khwan bam e Raguangc mei guay rui ndauh patmei
Ravguangc rui kandi hei kathanc damc thanh datmei tangv
Rupryan le, nang bamv t'ui thangc cho!
3. Zauc lo Ravguangc baansyam guay rui gaanc bame
Tingpuk hei nic che kiak kumc samctat kan pwni
Ravguangc rui kandi hei kathanc damc thanh datmei tangv
Nang bamv tei nchumh pwni cho!

songs.title: Zauzian Ganv hei Luai Kan Pwkhou

lines: 298 Zauzian Ganv hei Luai Kan Pwkhou
1. Zauzian ganv hei luai kan pwkhou,
Lwmmei nunc tei laathau kan khou,
Lungh ngiuc sihnic kaganv ri the.
Chu-zaenghmei hei nai dat lak khe.
Kaganv gay khou lungh laic la tho.
Kaipouc ta thaymei khou daicthau o,
Meic gaymei lat hei nkhuaihdui kumc
Meic guayna khang ndeih gay e.
Nang panty hei khuaihdui kumc o.
2. Ai rui nangniw khang nyngtyng tii e,
Machunhmei chaeng khou tatgut la tho,
Kaganv dui the, he chabwan guay.
Chabwan swbam khou neihlaa bam o;
Nang taanc nii taanc niimei taanc bam o.
Nang rui hamhna neihlaa kim khang maek;
Nang zauzian khwan rui tikimlou o.
Kapmei tingmik hei twan pwni the,
Ringhmei thingbang lim khou zaengsw 'ni the.
3. Nkhwan bam e arup-ryan guay rui;
Ringhmei thing lim khou zaengsw 'chamc khang.

songs.title: Zei Paan khourui Ata Thuakpatlou the

lines: 1. Zei paan khourui ata thuakpatlou the;
Kum sihnic 'thiammei rui zyn bam e.
Nang paanrui hamhna apumtan maek ge;
He aRavguangc, Zion ramc gaymei khou,
Ningtowlou o, Nang bangc Lazar ta kumc.
2. Nang Bumaengc rui akhou taanv swlou o;
Ai rui chaeng maanvna maengtat khwan sihnic,
Nang baanc rui ata zaylou na ro.
Kauh thu zaengthaek ta nkhwan bam ni.
Salem thanh gaymei khou guangtangc pwkhou,
Tingsaeng zaeng thuanhpui lu suan bam ni.
Noah kaanc khou pat kanmei kumc,
Nang nic khoutei kazauh ni cho?
Lunghlaic la tho kaganv maek khe.
Lungh ryanraana kapmei nai lak khe.
Lauziu Nac rui gaancna bam ni,
Kwm tingsaeng zaeng gaancna bam ni.
3. Kandih khou gaymei suang gay e,
Mwang rui saa tangc ngam thuy mak ge.
Hei khoutei gut nimei kiu thu
303 Zianmei nunc le, Kadan o, Bumaengh
1. Zianmei nunc le, kadan o Bumaengh maan kan nuh e,
Panty tingmik naibam saanv aniw guang thuanh khang e.
Ryanraa ryanriumei nai lah khe Tingkauh namvdai tei mu.
Neihlaa 'baanthaymei ramc tei t'ui nungc ai tangc ni cho?
Jisu (2) ram guoina dam chui lou
Jisu, 'patlou zat lak ge ata damc chuylou e.
Ch'ryn mei zauzian maan lak khe
Nang riw gaanc lik kan diu
2. Chingh zaengc duipui kapwmna nang rui damc chuylou,
Ruayna guay nic thuanc kan diu damcloumei Kaipouc ta.
Zinghmei khourui duakpatna panty naibam saanv,
Zauczihmei ta ngamlouna Lauziunac zei paanrui.
3. Heic kandic hei maan ngam ni Khrista guangpui nungc kiu,
Thyammei daihmei kapwmna Khrista thei laytat ni.
Lwmlou makmei kaguay tei theihmei ganv guang pwni.
Tingsaeng ryanraa ryanriumei riu pwni paap mei guay.
Pou' Jisu ta nang zauc o.
Pou' Jisu ta nang zauc o.
Pou' Jisu ta nang zauc o, (2)
Aseic hei nang ta kawbam the,
Pou' Jisu ta nang zauc o.
2. Theihmei kandic khou bammei nunc guay,
Pou' Jisu ta nang zauc o.
Pou Jisu ta nang zauc o.
3. Nang panty khou ryanraamei nai cho?
Pou' Jisu ta nang zauc o;
Nang lung khou lungclou khang ney o,
Pou Jisu ta nang zauc o.

songs.title: Zinghmei khou Ai Maengtatbam Khwan e.

lines: 305 Zinghmei khou Ai Maengtat Bam Khawne
1. Zinghmei khou ai maengtat bam khawn e,
2. Tingmik 'thuih Kahu khou ai lungc ni,
Paapcmei nunc ta Jisu khou 'duangh guang ni,
Ai kumc' paapc phunghmei ta gulou khang.
Tingkauh thu tingsaeng zaengna neihlaa ni.
Lwmloumei guay mu 'maan dat lak khe.
Guang tho Poubauhmei rui kaw bam khou.
